| R-240 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND21_20261012.md (binding; supersedes the round-11 whole-invoice reading) | After an invoice I1 is ISSUED and a worker's hours on it are amended or a shift removed: I1 is never edited; every other worker's Timesheet stays on I1, not credited and not re-invoiced; the affected Timesheet T0 is reversed in full by R0; the credit note is made from R0 (T0's lines only, linked to R0 — see the representation clause — value exactly −T0 on I1, `original_invoice_id` = I1), so R0's invoice home is the credit note; P0 carries the full corrected week on a new invoice, or, when no shift remains, is empty with no line and the credit note alone completes the correction. | R-240 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND21_20261012.md (binding; supersedes the round-11 whole-invoice reading) | After an invoice I1 is ISSUED and a worker's hours on it are amended or a shift removed: I1 is never edited; every other worker's Timesheet stays on I1, not credited and not re-invoiced; the affected Timesheet T0 is reversed in full by R0; the credit note is made from R0 (T0's lines only, linked to R0 — see the representation clause — value exactly −T0 on I1, `original_invoice_id` = I1), so R0's invoice home is the credit note; P0 carries the full corrected week on a new invoice, or, when no shift remains, is empty with no line and the credit note alone completes the correction. R0 and P0 are authorised together (R-205/R-214); pay nets to the difference (R-205); a new shift after issue needs no credit note; before issue the same-draft round trip applies (R-202/R-239); automatic Batch Generate, no Office button (R-203/R-228). Built as an optional `credit_scope` on the existing GENERATE_CREDIT_NOTE start core, resolver and advance; no parallel pipeline. **Representation (critic R21 M4):** R0 is placed on the credit note by being linked to it (`meta_json.reversal_timesheet_id` on every credit line) and locked to it (R0's TSFIN lock to CN), with value exactly −T0; the credit lines keep T0's `timesheet_id`, so the document shows T0's worker, week and hours with minus amounts. The owner's ruling stands; this is the representation only. I1 is never written (no mark); a second correction credits the record it reverses (`reversed_timesheet_id`) on that record's invoice. **Codex disposition R21-REP:** the independent review's suggestion to put R0 as the credit lines' `timesheet_id` is not adopted; this representation wins (T0 on the credit lines, R0 in `meta_json`). **Round-21 proof gates P-2…P-9, P-14 (`03` §26.6.2, §26.6.3):** completion only once the CN is issued; multi-line placement; the I1 overlap lock; own-operation resume; the legacy writers fenced; numbering; the issue child; no unissue of I1 under a credit. | `03` §26.6 |

original_rule_evidence.exact_text: | R-239 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND20_20261012.md R8-Q1 (binding) | An active admin, payment authoriser or golden-key holder may run the one-click unissued-draft round trip (remove the Timesheet from the draft, amend, return it to the SAME draft) for that Timesheet only, through one narrow service-only wrapper. The wrapper builds only `remove_invoice_line_ids` for that Timesheet's lines and `add_timesheet_ids` for its return to the same draft, and checks the shared pay-change predicate. All other invoice editing, `invoice_apply_edits` in general included, stays admin-only. **Codex R2 C02:** the invoice editor is unchanged (its admin check applies only on the non-service branch); every guard sits in the wrapper and the authorised Worker route, proved through the real Worker → PostgREST → wrapper path, with interruption recovery (DA-6). | `03` §25.2, §26.5 item 5 |

| R-240 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND21_20261012.md (binding; supersedes the round-11 whole-invoice reading) | After an invoice I1 is ISSUED and a worker's hours on it are amended or a shift removed: I1 is never edited; every other worker's Timesheet stays on I1, not credited and not re-invoiced; the affected Timesheet T0 is reversed in full by R0; the credit note is made from R0 (T0's lines only, linked to R0 — see the representation clause — value exactly −T0 on I1, `original_invoice_id` = I1), so R0's invoice home is the credit note; P0 carries the full corrected week on a new invoice, or, when no shift remains, is empty with no line and the credit note alone completes the correction. R0 and P0 are authorised together (R-205/R-214); pay nets to the difference (R-205); a new shift after issue needs no credit note; before issue the same-draft round trip applies (R-202/R-239); automatic Batch Generate, no Office button (R-203/R-228). Built as an optional `credit_scope` on the existing GENERATE_CREDIT_NOTE start core, resolver and advance; no parallel pipeline. **Representation (critic R21 M4):** R0 is placed on the credit note by being linked to it (`meta_json.reversal_timesheet_id` on every credit line) and locked to it (R0's TSFIN lock to CN), with value exactly −T0; the credit lines keep T0's `timesheet_id`, so the document shows T0's worker, week and hours with minus amounts. The owner's ruling stands; this is the representation only. I1 is never written (no mark); a second correction credits the record it reverses (`reversed_timesheet_id`) on that record's invoice. **Codex disposition R21-REP:** the independent review's suggestion to put R0 as the credit lines' `timesheet_id` is not adopted; this representation wins (T0 on the credit lines, R0 in `meta_json`). **Round-21 proof gates P-2…P-9, P-14 (`03` §26.6.2, §26.6.3):** completion only once the CN is issued; multi-line placement; the I1 overlap lock; own-operation resume; the legacy writers fenced; numbering; the issue child; no unissue of I1 under a credit. | `03` §26.6 |

| R-240 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND21_20261012.md (binding; supersedes the round-11 whole-invoice reading) | After an invoice I1 is ISSUED and a worker's hours on it are amended or a shift removed: I1 is never edited; every other worker's Timesheet stays on I1, not credited and not re-invoiced; the affected Timesheet T0 is reversed in full by R0; the credit note is made from R0 (T0's lines only, linked to R0 — see the representation clause — value exactly −T0 on I1, `original_invoice_id` = I1), so R0's invoice home is the credit note; P0 carries the full corrected week on a new invoice, or, when no shift remains, is empty with no line and the credit note alone completes the correction. R0 and P0 are authorised together (R-205/R-214); pay nets to the difference (R-205); a new shift after issue needs no credit note; before issue the same-draft round trip applies (R-202/R-239); automatic Batch Generate, no Office button (R-203/R-228). Built as an optional `credit_scope` on the existing GENERATE_CREDIT_NOTE start core, resolver and advance; no parallel pipeline. **Representation (critic R21 M4):** R0 is placed on the credit note by being linked to it (`meta_json.reversal_timesheet_id` on every credit line) and locked to it (R0's TSFIN lock to CN), with value exactly −T0; the credit lines keep T0's `timesheet_id`, so the document shows T0's worker, week and hours with minus amounts. GO-LIVE gate: NEXT nets the chain and keeps the paid revision's snapshot (handoff NX-CHK). | `03` §28.6 |

original_workgroup_rule_evidence.exact_text: | R-007 | workspace AGENTS.md Policy X | Policy X is preserved: no change to post-draft frozen artefacts, TS_DAY, freshness checks or economic keys. | all |

| R-213 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND12_20261012.md (owner correction, all presets) | A decrease after payment is **never refused**, in every preset: unprotect, protected hours amended down, source hours down, a removed shift after Accept source, and a whole reversal/replacement each create an **overpayment of the net difference only** in the overpayment system, never a full-amount debt. NEXT collectable overpayment (Weekly Source/protected FC-15 and ordinary PAYE + Umbrella/non-PAYE G5) is a GO-LIVE prerequisite; until collection exists NEXT must still record the overpayment for manual collection and never drop it. | all presets; handoff NX-REC |

| R-216 | owner via coordinator 12/10/2026 (one permission check); rounds 7–8 | The rule active AND (admin OR payment_authoriser OR payment_golden_key) exists once in SQL (`private.weekly_source_pay_actor_allowed_v1`) and once in the Worker (`broker/src/payment-actor-permission.js`); the shared check, the inline SQL sites S2–S10, the widened Worker sites W13–W17 call it; W1–W12 converge through handoff NX-WAIT (they already implement the same predicate and are not edited here; critic R8 item 19); Banking-named copies via handoff NX-WAIT. | `03` §25 |

| R-217 | Plan 6.2 CALL-ONLY boundary; round-5 critic M2 (adopted) | The hash-pinned owners `timesheet_authorise_generic_atomic` and `timesheet_unauthorise_atomic` (pinned by `supabase/verification/17092026_0610_weekly_source_withdrawal_supersession_v1.sql:1142-1160`) are never edited: the preset works through thin wrappers beside them (existing `tsfin_update_segments_locked` then the unchanged owner); if that proves impossible the build stops and reports under `07` §4 naming that verifier. No unauthorise successor is built. | `03` §26.5 item 4, §26.6.4 |

| R-218 | round-5 critic M4; ROUND14 item 2 (rewritten) | Protect, Amend and Unprotect change pay only, by the difference, on the protected-pay position (except a protected shift finalised at different hours, which has only Accept HealthRoster hours or Wait, R-227): no T0 edit, no unauthorise, no R0/P0, no invoice line effect (Unprotect of a still-waiting shift releases the week's invoice hold, R-222); replay-safe by request key. A **T0** change (alignment, a finalised-later shift on an uninvoiced T0) runs as one Office action: edit → Worker recalculation → authorise wrapper only when the TSFIN is fresh, so pay is never half-changed; for an already authorised T0 the system unauthorises and amends, and Office re-authorises through the normal route (R-202). | `03` §26.5 items 1, 3, 5 |

| R-244 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND22_20261012.md §4 (binding) | A check-only week waiting for HealthRoster is released only when HealthRoster fully matches. There is **no** Office "accept as checked" override. If HealthRoster is never corrected, the worker withdraws the claim in MyTMS and resubmits a new manager-signed Timesheet, which is checked again. Verified: this works today for an unpaid Timesheet (Office unauthorises, then rejects or the worker withdraws); for a paid one through R-248 (option B1) and for an invoiced one through R-249. | `03` §28.5, §28.6 |

| R-245 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND22_20261012.md §4 (binding) | For check-only clients pay does not wait; invoicing does. The worker is paid from the signed Timesheet on authorisation (NEXT reads no HealthRoster state) while the invoice waits (`READY_FOR_HR` / `HR_VALIDATION_BLOCKED`). The old pay-path hold is irrelevant under NEXT; handoff NX-CHK asks Banking Pay to confirm NEXT never gates pay on it. | `03` §28.5; handoff NX-CHK |

| R-248 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND22_20261012.md §6 (R22-Q1; binding), re-derived by R-250 | A paid but not-invoiced manager-signed Timesheet of a check-only client is corrected through Office's **Correct this Timesheet**. **HARD RULE (every state):** the replacement must itself be a manager-signed Timesheet with the new hours (the worker enters them in MyTMS, the manager signs); Office never types or edits signed hours (a guard beside `contract_week_manual_upsert_atomic`, `CHECK_ONLY_SIGNED_HOURS_OFFICE_EDIT_REFUSED`) and never authorises an unsigned replacement (Worker route plus deferred trigger, `CHECK_ONLY_REPLACEMENT_NOT_SIGNED`). **Since R-250** it uses the same mechanism as R-249: the original stays current and untouched; a replacement P0 waits in MyTMS; R0 and the signed P0 are authorised together; Cancel correction discards P0; the paid finance row is never moved or zeroed. The earlier reject-and-rotate route (extending `candidate_submission_reject_atomic_v1`, `_candidate_timesheet_reject_rotate_v1`, `_candidate_record_capabilities_v1`) is **withdrawn**. Not invoiced → placement `COMPLETE_UNINVOICED_PARENT` (R0 needs no line). Pay nets to the difference. GO-LIVE gate: NEXT nets the chain and keeps the paid revision's snapshot (handoff NX-CHK). | `03` §28.6 |

| R-249 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND22_20261012.md §6 (R22-Q2; binding) | A manager-signed Timesheet on an ISSUED invoice is corrected by a whole reversal plus a manager-signed replacement filled in by the worker in MyTMS, authorised together; a per-Timesheet credit note (round 21); the corrected Timesheet on a new invoice; other workers stay on the original invoice; pay nets to the difference. If the invoice never reached the client, Office may unissue first and it becomes a same-invoice draft round trip with the signed replacement. Built by EXTENDING the whole-correction owner (scope preset or check-only; origin `SIGNED_TIMESHEET_CORRECTION`; P0 at Send, R0 at Authorise both, Cancel correction), the pair-unit arms, the per-Timesheet credit note and the round-trip wrapper. **No route-family successor:** `_candidate_route_family_v1` already returns ELECTRONIC for an ELECTRONIC week snapshot (`24092026_2247…:172-176`); WP-0 proves that the Candidate listing and transition accept the adjustment week. NEXT chain netting NX-AI-3 is extended. | `03` §28.6, §26.6.2, §26.6.3, §25.2 |

| R-250 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND22_20261012.md §7 (R22C-Q1; binding; the critic's recommendation) | The original stays until replaced. In every state (authorised, paid, on a draft, issued), the original signed Timesheet stays current and untouched while a replacement draft waits in MyTMS for the worker to fill in and the manager to sign; nothing (pay, invoice or records) changes until Office authorises the signed replacement together with its reversal; Office has **Cancel correction**, which discards the draft; the paid finance row is never moved or zeroed (Policy X). One mechanism covers every state; it supersedes the reject-and-rotate route of R-248. | `03` §28.6 |

| R-253 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND22_20261012.md §9 (binding) | A reversal/replacement pair is authorised and unauthorised together through BOTH the single and the bulk authorise, starting from either member, with the same result and the same confirmation ("Both timesheets will be authorised together"; button "Authorise both" / "Unauthorise both"); in bulk one member or both is one unit. Reuses the existing expansion (`21072026_1235_00…:435-470`), the single pair flow and the bulk route, with the WHOLE arm for both origins; an unsigned check-only replacement is refused through every entry point. | `03` §28.9, §26.6.2 |

| R-255 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND22_20261012.md §11 (binding; UI critic Q2) | For check-only clients, **Correct this Timesheet** is also used for a manager-signed Timesheet that is **not yet authorised**, in place of today's Reject (state A0). The original stays untouched; at **Authorise both** the original, its reversal and the signed replacement are authorised together in one action, so only the corrected hours count and are paid; placement `COMPLETE_UNINVOICED_PARENT`. Reject of the **hours** is not offered for a signed check-only version, and the Office reject route refuses rejecting its hours (`CONTRACT_HOURS` / `CONTRACT_COMBINED`; `CHECK_ONLY_USE_CORRECT_THIS_TIMESHEET`, a Worker-route guard; the Candidate reject owner is not extended); rejecting an expense claim is unchanged (critic UI R2-5). In A0 the original is never shown as a plain "Authorised" in records or MyTMS, no authorised notification is sent, only the correction item shows while it waits, a lone Authorise of T0 warns, and NEXT pays exactly the replacement with no false overpayment (critic UI R2-4; handoff NX-CHK). | `03` §28.6, §28.9, §27.2 H |

| R-258 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND22_20261012.md §11 (binding; UI critic F15) | A daily correction is designed the same way as the weekly one. For a correction only, the MyTMS daily shift screen (`app/daily/shift.tsx`) shows "We've prefilled this with the corrected hours", highlights the changed times ("Changed: was … · now …"), says "If you think this is wrong, please call the office" and skips "Were these booked hours correct?"; it prefills from replacement draft schedule through existing dailySegments with correction-owned draft/alias/continuation initialization; only changed start/finish/break fields show exact original/proposed deltas; the worker confirms and sends, and the manager signs. **Critic UI R2-2:** the daily replacement's detail carries `daily_shift` frozen from the original booking, so it reaches the daily screen even after the booking has left the Rota window. | `03` §28.6, §27.2 H |

original_workgroup_rule_evidence.exact_text: | R-195 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND7_20261012.md | A protected-pay action (Protect pay, Amend, Withdraw/Unprotect, Record not worked, Reconcile / Accept source hours and reconcile, Wait) is allowed for an active user who is EITHER role admin (nothing else needed) OR has payment authoriser OR has golden key, whatever their role; one person, never a second approver; every other operation keeps its current rule. Explicit owner-approved scope exception (all Weekly Source clients, NHSP included), beside R-003 and R-175; replaces admin AND (authoriser OR golden key). Extended by round 8 to every pay-changing action (R-201). | WP-PP §25 |

| R-201 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND8_20261012.md | Every pay-changing action in scope — first Authorise and unauthorise/return of a Weekly Source week, all protected-pay actions, Accept source, Keep as paid, release of a pay hold, the later-change pay decision — uses the predicate active AND (admin OR payment authoriser OR golden key); one person; first Authorise is widened (no stricter check). A non-admin authoriser's Weekly Source/Imports workspace offers every pay-changing action and pay-related query and nothing else (uploads, import/group settings, invoice actions and Checklist confirmations stay admin-only). Weekly Source only (all groups incl. NHSP), plus — because the agency-invoice preset is in this plan's scope — the ordinary authorise/unauthorise, pair authorise, Protect pay and pay-state change of a Timesheet for which the agency-invoice preset predicate is true (`03` §26.3); every other ordinary, Daily and TIMESHEET_AUTHORITY authorisation outside Weekly Source is unchanged here. Extends R-195. Refined by R-234 (round 19): the Checklist is visible to a non-admin authoriser read-only, pay rows only. | WP-PP §25.1 |

| R-216 | owner via coordinator 12/10/2026 (one permission check); rounds 7–8 | The rule active AND (admin OR payment_authoriser OR payment_golden_key) exists once in SQL (`private.weekly_source_pay_actor_allowed_v1`) and once in the Worker (`broker/src/payment-actor-permission.js`); the shared check, the inline SQL sites S2–S10, the widened Worker sites W13–W17 call it; W1–W12 converge through handoff NX-WAIT (they already implement the same predicate and are not edited here; critic R8 item 19); Banking-named copies via handoff NX-WAIT. | `03` §25 |

| R-222 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND15_20261012.md items 2 and 7, and the owner-confirmed reconciliation | The invoiceable Timesheet holds **finalised HealthRoster shifts only**; an unfinalised shift, protected or not, is never on it. An **unprotected** waiting shift does not hold the invoice. A **protected** waiting shift **holds the week's invoice** until HealthRoster finalises it or Office unprotects it; unprotect = deemed not worked, the protected pay becomes an overpayment of the difference (never refused), and the week can then be invoiced. A protected shift finalised later is **always added to T0**, which cannot yet be invoiced, and its pay is **netted** against the protected pay already paid, by `candidate_id + work_date + work_event_id` (R-230; within T0's work normally, and across works whenever the shift or T0 lands on another work), never `booking_id`, `segment_id` or Request Id: top-up / overpayment of the difference / nothing. Then the protection clears and the shift becomes invoiceable. A new Timesheet is used **only after issue**: a new shift → new Timesheet and new invoice; changed or removed hours → R0/P0 and a credit note for that Timesheet only (R-240; round 17 item 3 removed the post-authorisation query case). | `03` §26.5 items 1, 3, 6; handoff NX-AI-6 |

original_rule_evidence.exact_text: | R-195 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND7_20261012.md | A protected-pay action (Protect pay, Amend, Withdraw/Unprotect, Record not worked, Reconcile / Accept source hours and reconcile, Wait) is allowed for an active user who is EITHER role admin (nothing else needed) OR has payment authoriser OR has golden key, whatever their role; one person, never a second approver; every other operation keeps its current rule. Explicit owner-approved scope exception (all Weekly Source clients, NHSP included), beside R-003 and R-175; replaces admin AND (authoriser OR golden key). Extended by round 8 to every pay-changing action (R-201). | WP-PP §25 |

| R-201 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND8_20261012.md | Every pay-changing action in scope — first Authorise and unauthorise/return of a Weekly Source week, all protected-pay actions, Accept source, Keep as paid, release of a pay hold, the later-change pay decision — uses the predicate active AND (admin OR payment authoriser OR golden key); one person; first Authorise is widened (no stricter check). A non-admin authoriser's Weekly Source/Imports workspace offers every pay-changing action and pay-related query and nothing else (uploads, import/group settings, invoice actions and Checklist confirmations stay admin-only). Weekly Source only (all groups incl. NHSP), plus — because the agency-invoice preset is in this plan's scope — the ordinary authorise/unauthorise, pair authorise, Protect pay and pay-state change of a Timesheet for which the agency-invoice preset predicate is true (`03` §26.3); every other ordinary, Daily and TIMESHEET_AUTHORITY authorisation outside Weekly Source is unchanged here. Extends R-195. Refined by R-234 (round 19): the Checklist is visible to a non-admin authoriser read-only, pay rows only. | WP-PP §25.1 |

| R-222 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND15_20261012.md items 2 and 7, and the owner-confirmed reconciliation | The invoiceable Timesheet holds **finalised HealthRoster shifts only**; an unfinalised shift, protected or not, is never on it. An **unprotected** waiting shift does not hold the invoice. A **protected** waiting shift **holds the week's invoice** until HealthRoster finalises it or Office unprotects it; unprotect = deemed not worked, the protected pay becomes an overpayment of the difference (never refused), and the week can then be invoiced. A protected shift finalised later is **always added to T0**, which cannot yet be invoiced, and its pay is **netted** against the protected pay already paid, by `candidate_id + work_date + work_event_id` (R-230; within T0's work normally, and across works whenever the shift or T0 lands on another work), never `booking_id`, `segment_id` or Request Id: top-up / overpayment of the difference / nothing. Then the protection clears and the shift becomes invoiceable. A new Timesheet is used **only after issue**: a new shift → new Timesheet and new invoice; changed or removed hours → R0/P0 and a credit note for that Timesheet only (R-240; round 17 item 3 removed the post-authorisation query case). | `03` §26.5 items 1, 3, 6; handoff NX-AI-6 |

original_workgroup_rule_evidence.exact_text: | R-195 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND7_20261012.md | A protected-pay action (Protect pay, Amend, Withdraw/Unprotect, Record not worked, Reconcile / Accept source hours and reconcile, Wait) is allowed for an active user who is EITHER role admin (nothing else needed) OR has payment authoriser OR has golden key, whatever their role; one person, never a second approver; every other operation keeps its current rule. Explicit owner-approved scope exception (all Weekly Source clients, NHSP included), beside R-003 and R-175; replaces admin AND (authoriser OR golden key). Extended by round 8 to every pay-changing action (R-201). | WP-PP §25 |

| R-201 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND8_20261012.md | Every pay-changing action in scope — first Authorise and unauthorise/return of a Weekly Source week, all protected-pay actions, Accept source, Keep as paid, release of a pay hold, the later-change pay decision — uses the predicate active AND (admin OR payment authoriser OR golden key); one person; first Authorise is widened (no stricter check). A non-admin authoriser's Weekly Source/Imports workspace offers every pay-changing action and pay-related query and nothing else (uploads, import/group settings, invoice actions and Checklist confirmations stay admin-only). Weekly Source only (all groups incl. NHSP), plus — because the agency-invoice preset is in this plan's scope — the ordinary authorise/unauthorise, pair authorise, Protect pay and pay-state change of a Timesheet for which the agency-invoice preset predicate is true (`03` §26.3); every other ordinary, Daily and TIMESHEET_AUTHORITY authorisation outside Weekly Source is unchanged here. Extends R-195. Refined by R-234 (round 19): the Checklist is visible to a non-admin authoriser read-only, pay rows only. | WP-PP §25.1 |

| R-216 | owner via coordinator 12/10/2026 (one permission check); rounds 7–8 | The rule active AND (admin OR payment_authoriser OR payment_golden_key) exists once in SQL (`private.weekly_source_pay_actor_allowed_v1`) and once in the Worker (`broker/src/payment-actor-permission.js`); the shared check, the inline SQL sites S2–S10, the widened Worker sites W13–W17 call it; W1–W12 converge through handoff NX-WAIT (they already implement the same predicate and are not edited here; critic R8 item 19); Banking-named copies via handoff NX-WAIT. | `03` §25 |

| R-222 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND15_20261012.md items 2 and 7, and the owner-confirmed reconciliation | The invoiceable Timesheet holds **finalised HealthRoster shifts only**; an unfinalised shift, protected or not, is never on it. An **unprotected** waiting shift does not hold the invoice. A **protected** waiting shift **holds the week's invoice** until HealthRoster finalises it or Office unprotects it; unprotect = deemed not worked, the protected pay becomes an overpayment of the difference (never refused), and the week can then be invoiced. A protected shift finalised later is **always added to T0**, which cannot yet be invoiced, and its pay is **netted** against the protected pay already paid, by `candidate_id + work_date + work_event_id` (R-230; within T0's work normally, and across works whenever the shift or T0 lands on another work), never `booking_id`, `segment_id` or Request Id: top-up / overpayment of the difference / nothing. Then the protection clears and the shift becomes invoiceable. A new Timesheet is used **only after issue**: a new shift → new Timesheet and new invoice; changed or removed hours → R0/P0 and a credit note for that Timesheet only (R-240; round 17 item 3 removed the post-authorisation query case). | `03` §26.5 items 1, 3, 6; handoff NX-AI-6 |

original_rule_evidence.exact_text: | R-195 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND7_20261012.md | A protected-pay action (Protect pay, Amend, Withdraw/Unprotect, Record not worked, Reconcile / Accept source hours and reconcile, Wait) is allowed for an active user who is EITHER role admin (nothing else needed) OR has payment authoriser OR has golden key, whatever their role; one person, never a second approver; every other operation keeps its current rule. Extended by round 8 to every pay-changing action (R-201). | WP-PP §25 |

| R-201 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND8_20261012.md | Every pay-changing action in scope — first Authorise and unauthorise/return of a Weekly Source week, all protected-pay actions, Accept source, Keep as paid, release of a pay hold, the later-change pay decision — uses the predicate active AND (admin OR payment authoriser OR golden key); one person; first Authorise is widened (no stricter check). A non-admin authoriser's Weekly Source/Imports workspace offers every pay-changing action and pay-related query and nothing else (uploads, import/group settings, invoice actions and Checklist confirmations stay admin-only). Weekly Source only (all groups incl. NHSP), plus — because the agency-invoice preset is in this plan's scope — the ordinary authorise/unauthorise, pair authorise, Protect pay and pay-state change of a Timesheet for which the agency-invoice preset predicate is true (`03` §26.3); every other ordinary, Daily and TIMESHEET_AUTHORITY authorisation outside Weekly Source is unchanged here. Extends R-195. Refined by R-234 (round 19): the Checklist is visible to a non-admin authoriser read-only, pay rows only. | WP-PP §25.1 |

| R-222 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND15_20261012.md items 2 and 7, and the owner-confirmed reconciliation | The invoiceable Timesheet holds **finalised HealthRoster shifts only**; an unfinalised shift, protected or not, is never on it. An **unprotected** waiting shift does not hold the invoice. A **protected** waiting shift **holds the week's invoice** until HealthRoster finalises it or Office unprotects it; unprotect = deemed not worked, the protected pay becomes an overpayment of the difference (never refused), and the week can then be invoiced. A protected shift finalised later is **always added to T0**, which cannot yet be invoiced, and its pay is **netted** against the protected pay already paid, by `candidate_id + work_date + work_event_id` (R-230; within T0's work normally, and across works whenever the shift or T0 lands on another work), never `booking_id`, `segment_id` or Request Id: top-up / overpayment of the difference / nothing. Then the protection clears and the shift becomes invoiceable. A new Timesheet is used **only after issue**: a new shift → new Timesheet and new invoice; changed or removed hours → R0/P0 and a credit note for that Timesheet only (R-240; round 17 item 3 removed the post-authorisation query case). | `03` §26.5 items 1, 3, 6; handoff NX-AI-6 |

original_workgroup_rule_evidence.exact_text: | R-195 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND7_20261012.md | A protected-pay action (Protect pay, Amend, Withdraw/Unprotect, Record not worked, Reconcile / Accept source hours and reconcile, Wait) is allowed for an active user who is EITHER role admin (nothing else needed) OR has payment authoriser OR has golden key, whatever their role; one person, never a second approver; every other operation keeps its current rule. Explicit owner-approved scope exception (all Weekly Source clients, NHSP included), beside R-003 and R-175; replaces admin AND (authoriser OR golden key). Extended by round 8 to every pay-changing action (R-201). | WP-PP §25 |

| R-201 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND8_20261012.md | Every pay-changing action in scope — first Authorise and unauthorise/return of a Weekly Source week, all protected-pay actions, Accept source, Keep as paid, release of a pay hold, the later-change pay decision — uses the predicate active AND (admin OR payment authoriser OR golden key); one person; first Authorise is widened (no stricter check). A non-admin authoriser's Weekly Source/Imports workspace offers every pay-changing action and pay-related query and nothing else (uploads, import/group settings, invoice actions and Checklist confirmations stay admin-only). Weekly Source only (all groups incl. NHSP), plus — because the agency-invoice preset is in this plan's scope — the ordinary authorise/unauthorise, pair authorise, Protect pay and pay-state change of a Timesheet for which the agency-invoice preset predicate is true (`03` §26.3); every other ordinary, Daily and TIMESHEET_AUTHORITY authorisation outside Weekly Source is unchanged here. Extends R-195. Refined by R-234 (round 19): the Checklist is visible to a non-admin authoriser read-only, pay rows only. | WP-PP §25.1 |

| R-216 | owner via coordinator 12/10/2026 (one permission check); rounds 7–8 | The rule active AND (admin OR payment_authoriser OR payment_golden_key) exists once in SQL (`private.weekly_source_pay_actor_allowed_v1`) and once in the Worker (`broker/src/payment-actor-permission.js`); the shared check, the inline SQL sites S2–S10, the widened Worker sites W13–W17 call it; W1–W12 converge through handoff NX-WAIT (they already implement the same predicate and are not edited here; critic R8 item 19); Banking-named copies via handoff NX-WAIT. | `03` §25 |

| R-222 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND15_20261012.md items 2 and 7, and the owner-confirmed reconciliation | The invoiceable Timesheet holds **finalised HealthRoster shifts only**; an unfinalised shift, protected or not, is never on it. An **unprotected** waiting shift does not hold the invoice. A **protected** waiting shift **holds the week's invoice** until HealthRoster finalises it or Office unprotects it; unprotect = deemed not worked, the protected pay becomes an overpayment of the difference (never refused), and the week can then be invoiced. A protected shift finalised later is **always added to T0**, which cannot yet be invoiced, and its pay is **netted** against the protected pay already paid, by `candidate_id + work_date + work_event_id` (R-230; within T0's work normally, and across works whenever the shift or T0 lands on another work), never `booking_id`, `segment_id` or Request Id: top-up / overpayment of the difference / nothing. Then the protection clears and the shift becomes invoiceable. A new Timesheet is used **only after issue**: a new shift → new Timesheet and new invoice; changed or removed hours → R0/P0 and a credit note for that Timesheet only (R-240; round 17 item 3 removed the post-authorisation query case). | `03` §26.5 items 1, 3, 6; handoff NX-AI-6 |

original_workgroup_rule_evidence.exact_text: | R-195 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND7_20261012.md | A protected-pay action (Protect pay, Amend, Withdraw/Unprotect, Record not worked, Reconcile / Accept source hours and reconcile, Wait) is allowed for an active user who is EITHER role admin (nothing else needed) OR has payment authoriser OR has golden key, whatever their role; one person, never a second approver; every other operation keeps its current rule. Explicit owner-approved scope exception (all Weekly Source clients, NHSP included), beside R-003 and R-175; replaces admin AND (authoriser OR golden key). Extended by round 8 to every pay-changing action (R-201). | WP-PP §25 |

| R-201 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND8_20261012.md | Every pay-changing action in scope — first Authorise and unauthorise/return of a Weekly Source week, all protected-pay actions, Accept source, Keep as paid, release of a pay hold, the later-change pay decision — uses the predicate active AND (admin OR payment authoriser OR golden key); one person; first Authorise is widened (no stricter check). A non-admin authoriser's Weekly Source/Imports workspace offers every pay-changing action and pay-related query and nothing else (uploads, import/group settings, invoice actions and Checklist confirmations stay admin-only). Weekly Source only (all groups incl. NHSP), plus — because the agency-invoice preset is in this plan's scope — the ordinary authorise/unauthorise, pair authorise, Protect pay and pay-state change of a Timesheet for which the agency-invoice preset predicate is true (`03` §26.3); every other ordinary, Daily and TIMESHEET_AUTHORITY authorisation outside Weekly Source is unchanged here. Extends R-195. Refined by R-234 (round 19): the Checklist is visible to a non-admin authoriser read-only, pay rows only. | WP-PP §25.1 |

| R-216 | owner via coordinator 12/10/2026 (one permission check); rounds 7–8 | The rule active AND (admin OR payment_authoriser OR payment_golden_key) exists once in SQL (`private.weekly_source_pay_actor_allowed_v1`) and once in the Worker (`broker/src/payment-actor-permission.js`); the shared check, the inline SQL sites S2–S10, the widened Worker sites W13–W17 call it; W1–W12 converge through handoff NX-WAIT (they already implement the same predicate and are not edited here; critic R8 item 19); Banking-named copies via handoff NX-WAIT. | `03` §25 |

| R-222 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND15_20261012.md items 2 and 7, and the owner-confirmed reconciliation | The invoiceable Timesheet holds **finalised HealthRoster shifts only**; an unfinalised shift, protected or not, is never on it. An **unprotected** waiting shift does not hold the invoice. A **protected** waiting shift **holds the week's invoice** until HealthRoster finalises it or Office unprotects it; unprotect = deemed not worked, the protected pay becomes an overpayment of the difference (never refused), and the week can then be invoiced. A protected shift finalised later is **always added to T0**, which cannot yet be invoiced, and its pay is **netted** against the protected pay already paid, by `candidate_id + work_date + work_event_id` (R-230; within T0's work normally, and across works whenever the shift or T0 lands on another work), never `booking_id`, `segment_id` or Request Id: top-up / overpayment of the difference / nothing. Then the protection clears and the shift becomes invoiceable. A new Timesheet is used **only after issue**: a new shift → new Timesheet and new invoice; changed or removed hours → R0/P0 and a credit note for that Timesheet only (R-240; round 17 item 3 removed the post-authorisation query case). | `03` §26.5 items 1, 3, 6; handoff NX-AI-6 |

original_workgroup_rule_evidence.exact_text: | R-003 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND4_20261011.md (final answers) | Q-CEND: the Contract end/start-date guard is repaired for ALL clients using real worked dates (schedule/segments; Daily worked date); clone-and-extend unchanged. One of the owner-approved scope exceptions (the full list is in R-002: R-003, R-175, R-195/R-201/R-234, R-223, R-224/R-232/R-236, R-221, R-243–R-247; R-213's ordinary PAYE/Umbrella part is Banking Pay's and not built here). It also reads non-cancelled `nhsp_shifts.work_date` and the TSFIN worked dates, because import-backed originals can have an empty schedule (R-196, CE-6). | WP-F9 |

| R-021 | 11/10/2026 owner via coordinator ruling 10 | Workers are paid finalised source hours, or protected pay pre-filled from the worker-signed MyTMS submission; protect, reconcile, unprotect. For Acacium, finalised source hours are paid only once the shift is on the accepted Acacium report, or when protected (R-176). | WP-F7, P |

| R-178 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND6_20261012.md FE-M02 / N-M04 | "✗ Holds pay" appears only when a real, scoped amount is actually withheld from the worker; an Office decision that withholds nothing shows amber "! Decision needed" with the choice in the sub-line; approved or already-paid money is kept until Office decides; "✗ Holds invoice" stays red where the invoice genuinely cannot be created. Supersedes the round-5 "turns red". | §24.8, §10 |

| R-195 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND7_20261012.md | A protected-pay action (Protect pay, Amend, Withdraw/Unprotect, Record not worked, Reconcile / Accept source hours and reconcile, Wait) is allowed for an active user who is EITHER role admin (nothing else needed) OR has payment authoriser OR has golden key, whatever their role; one person, never a second approver; every other operation keeps its current rule. Explicit owner-approved scope exception (all Weekly Source clients, NHSP included), beside R-003 and R-175; replaces admin AND (authoriser OR golden key). Extended by round 8 to every pay-changing action (R-201). | WP-PP §25 |

| R-201 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND8_20261012.md | Every pay-changing action in scope — first Authorise and unauthorise/return of a Weekly Source week, all protected-pay actions, Accept source, Keep as paid, release of a pay hold, the later-change pay decision — uses the predicate active AND (admin OR payment authoriser OR golden key); one person; first Authorise is widened (no stricter check). A non-admin authoriser's Weekly Source/Imports workspace offers every pay-changing action and pay-related query and nothing else (uploads, import/group settings, invoice actions and Checklist confirmations stay admin-only). Weekly Source only (all groups incl. NHSP), plus — because the agency-invoice preset is in this plan's scope — the ordinary authorise/unauthorise, pair authorise, Protect pay and pay-state change of a Timesheet for which the agency-invoice preset predicate is true (`03` §26.3); every other ordinary, Daily and TIMESHEET_AUTHORITY authorisation outside Weekly Source is unchanged here. Extends R-195. Refined by R-234 (round 19): the Checklist is visible to a non-admin authoriser read-only, pay rows only. | WP-PP §25.1 |

| R-213 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND12_20261012.md (owner correction, all presets) | A decrease after payment is **never refused**, in every preset: unprotect, protected hours amended down, source hours down, a removed shift after Accept source, and a whole reversal/replacement each create an **overpayment of the net difference only** in the overpayment system, never a full-amount debt. NEXT collectable overpayment (Weekly Source/protected FC-15 and ordinary PAYE + Umbrella/non-PAYE G5) is a GO-LIVE prerequisite; until collection exists NEXT must still record the overpayment for manual collection and never drop it. | all presets; handoff NX-REC |

| R-216 | owner via coordinator 12/10/2026 (one permission check); rounds 7–8 | The rule active AND (admin OR payment_authoriser OR payment_golden_key) exists once in SQL (`private.weekly_source_pay_actor_allowed_v1`) and once in the Worker (`broker/src/payment-actor-permission.js`); the shared check, the inline SQL sites S2–S10, the widened Worker sites W13–W17 call it; W1–W12 converge through handoff NX-WAIT (they already implement the same predicate and are not edited here; critic R8 item 19); Banking-named copies via handoff NX-WAIT. | `03` §25 |

| R-217 | Plan 6.2 CALL-ONLY boundary; round-5 critic M2 (adopted) | The hash-pinned owners `timesheet_authorise_generic_atomic` and `timesheet_unauthorise_atomic` (pinned by `supabase/verification/17092026_0610_weekly_source_withdrawal_supersession_v1.sql:1142-1160`) are never edited: the preset works through thin wrappers beside them (existing `tsfin_update_segments_locked` then the unchanged owner); if that proves impossible the build stops and reports under `07` §4 naming that verifier. No unauthorise successor is built. | `03` §26.5 item 4, §26.6.4 |

| R-218 | round-5 critic M4; ROUND14 item 2 (rewritten) | Protect, Amend and Unprotect change pay only, by the difference, on the protected-pay position (except a protected shift finalised at different hours, which has only Accept HealthRoster hours or Wait, R-227): no T0 edit, no unauthorise, no R0/P0, no invoice line effect (Unprotect of a still-waiting shift releases the week's invoice hold, R-222); replay-safe by request key. A **T0** change (alignment, a finalised-later shift on an uninvoiced T0) runs as one Office action: edit → Worker recalculation → authorise wrapper only when the TSFIN is fresh, so pay is never half-changed; for an already authorised T0 the system unauthorises and amends, and Office re-authorises through the normal route (R-202). | `03` §26.5 items 1, 3, 5 |

| R-236 | Owner ruling 12/10/2026 via coordinator (binding; all groups, NHSP included) | No source, Trust/client or file-type choice at upload, for every Weekly Source group. The upload panel is one "Upload source file" button; the list filters stay as filters. A successor of `resolveWeeklySourceProfile` returns the single detected profile when none is supplied (the explicit path stays for compatibility); the Acacium report profile joins detection, with a collision proof. Group and client come from the file: NHSP final from its heading and Trust; NHSP released from each row's Trust; weekly HealthRoster exports and roster summary from worker + date → dated Contract; DAILY HealthRoster from exact current Daily Timesheet/client/work-date resolver with optional Contract; the Acacium report from its Request Ids, else Staff + date, else the single Acacium client. The client picker or linking dialogs appear only when nothing resolves the client or more than one does. The preview states in one line what was recognised. Extends R-224. **Round 22 (R-243, R-247):** before any group or staging is chosen, resolve actual client/current Timesheet/work date and dated authority (weekly Contract; DAILY optional Contract); check-only weekly files go to the signed-Timesheet group, daily HealthRoster files open the durable daily review, and a cross-client guard applies (`03` §28.1). **Codex R2 C07:** profile, client, group, dates and eligible operation/cycle are derived and validated per file on the server; the latest scoped cycle is only a default; old or finalised files go to the eligible historical flow or are refused precisely; every file is preflighted before any is staged. | `03` §26.13b |

| R-237 | Owner request 12/10/2026 via coordinator; owner confirmation round 19 (agency Checklist column) | The Imports screens are simple by design, consolidated in `03` §27: one button to upload, one place per issue, every blocker naming the client, worker, week, reason and one action, continuous scrolling, the same wording everywhere ("Protected shifts" for the place, "Accept source hours" in Queries, the existing coverage confirmation, one Finalise wording for Surrey and Magnit-style). For the agency style, the Checklist's second column means "nothing outstanding": ✓ when nothing holds pay or the invoice; invoicing is not a deciding factor, and no "Ready to invoice" blocker exists. | `03` §27 |

| R-243 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND22_20261012.md §2 (binding) | Check-only HealthRoster clients (the manager-signed Timesheet is authoritative), Weekly and Daily, are fully in the new Imports system: one **Upload source file** button; the file's route is resolved from exact current Timesheet/client/work date and dated authority before group/staging (weekly Contract; DAILY optional Contract) (`_import_review_effective_authority_core_v1` VALIDATION_ONLY → the client's signed-Timesheet group through Mode A; daily HealthRoster file → the existing durable daily review); cross-client guard; check-only clients cannot join self-bill or AGENCY_INVOICE groups; signed hours compared with HealthRoster; Temp Staffing queried about every difference with reminders, and the query reliably reaches `mail_outbox`; the Timesheet and pay never change because of HealthRoster; presented in the existing screens (§27.2 F/G). Existing comparison, review, query-email and hold owners reused; no parallel system. | `03` §28, §27 |

| R-252 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND22_20261012.md §9 (binding) | Check-only clients (weekly and daily) appear in the Imports Checklist, one compact row per client per week like the other groups, **only** when they have actual current Timesheets in that week, or an earlier week (back to the client's signed-Timesheet group membership start) still has a Timesheet not authorised or still held for HealthRoster. Checked (formerly Pre-finalise, R-257) = every counted Timesheet compared with an accepted HealthRoster file; Completed (formerly Finalise) = nothing outstanding (all authorised and matched, no query unsent, no correction waiting). Items name the worker, week, reason and one action linked to its single place (Queries, the daily review, the Timesheet modal, Upload); HealthRoster never holds pay. Built as one arm of the planned Checklist reader with two new link kinds. **Owner round 22 §11 (done weeks):** the current week's row stays, ✓ ✓ when completed; earlier weeks appear only while something is open there and drop off once done. **UI critic pass:** an actual Timesheet is a submitted one; a superseded original and its reversal are not counted, only the replacement; one item per Timesheet whose state moves on; items are links "‹action› in ‹place› ›"; daily items live in Queries like weekly ones; a non-admin authoriser sees a row only with a pay item. **Critic UI round 2 (R2-6):** the current check-only row's grey line reads "Nothing outstanding · earlier weeks all done" or "Nothing outstanding this week · 1 earlier week open"; the Group tooltip explains the rule. | `03` §28.8, §26.14, §27 |

original_workgroup_rule_evidence.exact_text: | R-031 | parity 04_OPEN_QUESTIONS + owner 11/10/2026 Q1 reversed | An unfinalised row is query (a) "Not finalised by the client" when the worker submitted/signed it or a non-cancelled Contract Week expects work; otherwise information only. | WP-P2 |

| R-085 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND1_20261011.md Q-CHASE; OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND3_20261011.md | The client's manager is asked to finalise before the cut-off, from the first checking import (no earlier than the Monday after the week); the worker is not asked. An import before that Monday raises the query for Office but emails nobody (R-174). | WP-P2b |

| R-181 | Codex verification item 3 (adopted; owner rules R-031, R-085, R-174) | A Contract Week expecting work with no signed Timesheet still gets its "not finalised" query at publication, manager-only and Monday-deferred, without inventing Candidate evidence. | §24.3 |

| R-200 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND9_20261012.md items 1–3; round-5 critic reuse re-plan | A preset Timesheet is invoiced only when its **whole week** is complete (ticked coverage of every day; every shift **on T0** finalised — an unfinalised or missing unprotected shift is not on T0 and never holds, R-222; no unresolved query raised before authorisation about a shift on T0; records equal finalised HealthRoster — higher HealthRoster hours accepted once aligned, R-209; records authorised with a pair only as one unit; no pending correction decision; no protected shift still waiting, R-222). Reminders never hold; there are no post-authorisation worker queries (R-226). The **existing** HealthRoster-validation hold (`timesheet_validations` → READY_FOR_HR, `HR_VALIDATION_BLOCKED`, `HEALTHROSTER_VALIDATION_REQUIRED`) does the holding: one completeness writer writes `VALIDATION_OK` only when complete and `VALIDATION_ERROR` with the reason otherwise; no other writer (legacy validate route and Mode A apply refuse preset Timesheets); no OVERRIDDEN; issue and send enforced by one arm in the existing `_invoice_issue_validate_batch`; no new gate; no cut-off. | WP-AI-2 §26.4 |

| R-219 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND13_20261012.md items 1–2; ROUND17 item 3 | A late worker submission is accepted **until Office authorises T0**: over a "Use HealthRoster hours" T0 it is admitted through one preset arm in `_candidate_record_capabilities_v1`, compared again, and a mismatch reopens the query and Protect pay. **Once T0 is authorised, the worker can no longer query or submit changes for its shifts in MyTMS**: the existing authorised-record lock applies (`04092026_1603…:230-235`; `10102026_1347…:1045-1051`), extended to the Weekly Source query read, answer and ask owners (QD `:144, 2473, 3216`). There are no post-authorisation worker queries (supersedes round 14 item 6; Q-R16-A resolved). After issue, changes come only from HealthRoster imports (post-issue route). | `03` §26.5 item 7, §26.5c |

| R-220 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND13_20261012.md items 3–5; ROUND14–15 | Re-imports are unlimited. A week matches when every T0 shift is finalised and agrees, no query raised before authorisation about a shift on T0 is open (a query about an unfinalised or missing unprotected shift never counts), no protected shift is still waiting and none is finalised at different hours unresolved, and the export is ticked complete. Agreement comes from a later import or from Office's Accept HealthRoster hours (R-227); Unprotect of a still-waiting shift ends its protection (deemed not worked; it was never on T0) and releases the hold. Only then is `VALIDATION_OK` written and the invoice prepared by normal Batch Generate. Reminders never count; there are no post-authorisation worker queries. | `03` §26.5c, §26.4 |

| R-224 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND15_20261012.md item 5; ROUND17 items 5–6; critic round 7 §4 | No journey or file-type choice at upload, for every Weekly Source upload; the "File type" selector is removed and the Acacium report is recognised from its layout plus the client's settings. The layout is detected by the existing `allProfileCandidates`. A HealthRoster export has no client column, so the client is found by a **read-only detection step before staging**, using one shared candidate-match helper (extracted from `weekly_source_upload_context_v1`): Staff → Candidate → Contract on that date at an eligible client. Unresolved rows use the **existing** dialogs: Link candidate, Choose contract (with Create contract), and the client picker for no client or two clients. Only configuration errors stay plain refusals. Extended by R-236: no source, Trust/client or file-type choice for any group, NHSP included. **Round 22 (R-243):** detection first resolves each Contract's HealthRoster route (check-only weekly → signed-Timesheet group; daily HealthRoster file → the durable daily review). | `03` §26.13 |

| R-232 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND19_20261012.md CR8-Q1 (binding) | The system always knows whether an import is a finalisation import; the user is never asked. The NHSP final report and the Acacium report are known from the file; the agency style is always a check. For a same-file group (Surrey-type, Magnit-style, the Acacium export) every export is accepted as a check, and Finalise **offers** the current file only when the group's earliest-final time S12 has passed (Magnit-style: its own cut-off, R-238), the file was uploaded at or after that time, and its confirmed coverage is COMPLETE for the whole cycle week. One Finalise click runs the existing PREPARE then FINALISE commands; the preview chooser and the separate "Prepare current file for finalisation" button are removed. "Use this file to finalise … later in Finalise? Yes / Check only" is asked only when the rule cannot decide (a same-file group with no rule set). **Codex R2 C08:** PREPARE and FINALISE both enforce all four conditions against the locked upload, cycle and publication; an earlier or legacy preparation cannot waive them. | `03` §26.13a |

| R-236 | Owner ruling 12/10/2026 via coordinator (binding; all groups, NHSP included) | No source, Trust/client or file-type choice at upload, for every Weekly Source group. The upload panel is one "Upload source file" button; the list filters stay as filters. A successor of `resolveWeeklySourceProfile` returns the single detected profile when none is supplied (the explicit path stays for compatibility); the Acacium report profile joins detection, with a collision proof. Group and client come from the file: NHSP final from its heading and Trust; NHSP released from each row's Trust; weekly HealthRoster exports and roster summary from worker + date → dated Contract; DAILY HealthRoster from exact current Daily Timesheet/client/work-date resolver with optional Contract; the Acacium report from its Request Ids, else Staff + date, else the single Acacium client. The client picker or linking dialogs appear only when nothing resolves the client or more than one does. The preview states in one line what was recognised. Extends R-224. **Round 22 (R-243, R-247):** before any group or staging is chosen, resolve actual client/current Timesheet/work date and dated authority (weekly Contract; DAILY optional Contract); check-only weekly files go to the signed-Timesheet group, daily HealthRoster files open the durable daily review, and a cross-client guard applies (`03` §28.1). **Codex R2 C07:** profile, client, group, dates and eligible operation/cycle are derived and validated per file on the server; the latest scoped cycle is only a default; old or finalised files go to the eligible historical flow or are refused precisely; every file is preflighted before any is staged. | `03` §26.13b |

| R-237 | Owner request 12/10/2026 via coordinator; owner confirmation round 19 (agency Checklist column) | The Imports screens are simple by design, consolidated in `03` §27: one button to upload, one place per issue, every blocker naming the client, worker, week, reason and one action, continuous scrolling, the same wording everywhere ("Protected shifts" for the place, "Accept source hours" in Queries, the existing coverage confirmation, one Finalise wording for Surrey and Magnit-style). For the agency style, the Checklist's second column means "nothing outstanding": ✓ when nothing holds pay or the invoice; invoicing is not a deciding factor, and no "Ready to invoice" blocker exists. | `03` §27 |

| R-243 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND22_20261012.md §2 (binding) | Check-only HealthRoster clients (the manager-signed Timesheet is authoritative), Weekly and Daily, are fully in the new Imports system: one **Upload source file** button; the file's route is resolved from exact current Timesheet/client/work date and dated authority before group/staging (weekly Contract; DAILY optional Contract) (`_import_review_effective_authority_core_v1` VALIDATION_ONLY → the client's signed-Timesheet group through Mode A; daily HealthRoster file → the existing durable daily review); cross-client guard; check-only clients cannot join self-bill or AGENCY_INVOICE groups; signed hours compared with HealthRoster; Temp Staffing queried about every difference with reminders, and the query reliably reaches `mail_outbox`; the Timesheet and pay never change because of HealthRoster; presented in the existing screens (§27.2 F/G). Existing comparison, review, query-email and hold owners reused; no parallel system. | `03` §28, §27 |

| R-252 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND22_20261012.md §9 (binding) | Check-only clients (weekly and daily) appear in the Imports Checklist, one compact row per client per week like the other groups, **only** when they have actual current Timesheets in that week, or an earlier week (back to the client's signed-Timesheet group membership start) still has a Timesheet not authorised or still held for HealthRoster. Checked (formerly Pre-finalise, R-257) = every counted Timesheet compared with an accepted HealthRoster file; Completed (formerly Finalise) = nothing outstanding (all authorised and matched, no query unsent, no correction waiting). Items name the worker, week, reason and one action linked to its single place (Queries, the daily review, the Timesheet modal, Upload); HealthRoster never holds pay. Built as one arm of the planned Checklist reader with two new link kinds. **Owner round 22 §11 (done weeks):** the current week's row stays, ✓ ✓ when completed; earlier weeks appear only while something is open there and drop off once done. **UI critic pass:** an actual Timesheet is a submitted one; a superseded original and its reversal are not counted, only the replacement; one item per Timesheet whose state moves on; items are links "‹action› in ‹place› ›"; daily items live in Queries like weekly ones; a non-admin authoriser sees a row only with a pay item. **Critic UI round 2 (R2-6):** the current check-only row's grey line reads "Nothing outstanding · earlier weeks all done" or "Nothing outstanding this week · 1 earlier week open"; the Group tooltip explains the rule. | `03` §28.8, §26.14, §27 |

original_workgroup_rule_evidence.exact_text: | R-195 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND7_20261012.md | A protected-pay action (Protect pay, Amend, Withdraw/Unprotect, Record not worked, Reconcile / Accept source hours and reconcile, Wait) is allowed for an active user who is EITHER role admin (nothing else needed) OR has payment authoriser OR has golden key, whatever their role; one person, never a second approver; every other operation keeps its current rule. Explicit owner-approved scope exception (all Weekly Source clients, NHSP included), beside R-003 and R-175; replaces admin AND (authoriser OR golden key). Extended by round 8 to every pay-changing action (R-201). | WP-PP §25 |

| R-201 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND8_20261012.md | Every pay-changing action in scope — first Authorise and unauthorise/return of a Weekly Source week, all protected-pay actions, Accept source, Keep as paid, release of a pay hold, the later-change pay decision — uses the predicate active AND (admin OR payment authoriser OR golden key); one person; first Authorise is widened (no stricter check). A non-admin authoriser's Weekly Source/Imports workspace offers every pay-changing action and pay-related query and nothing else (uploads, import/group settings, invoice actions and Checklist confirmations stay admin-only). Weekly Source only (all groups incl. NHSP), plus — because the agency-invoice preset is in this plan's scope — the ordinary authorise/unauthorise, pair authorise, Protect pay and pay-state change of a Timesheet for which the agency-invoice preset predicate is true (`03` §26.3); every other ordinary, Daily and TIMESHEET_AUTHORITY authorisation outside Weekly Source is unchanged here. Extends R-195. Refined by R-234 (round 19): the Checklist is visible to a non-admin authoriser read-only, pay rows only. | WP-PP §25.1 |

| R-216 | owner via coordinator 12/10/2026 (one permission check); rounds 7–8 | The rule active AND (admin OR payment_authoriser OR payment_golden_key) exists once in SQL (`private.weekly_source_pay_actor_allowed_v1`) and once in the Worker (`broker/src/payment-actor-permission.js`); the shared check, the inline SQL sites S2–S10, the widened Worker sites W13–W17 call it; W1–W12 converge through handoff NX-WAIT (they already implement the same predicate and are not edited here; critic R8 item 19); Banking-named copies via handoff NX-WAIT. | `03` §25 |

| R-222 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND15_20261012.md items 2 and 7, and the owner-confirmed reconciliation | The invoiceable Timesheet holds **finalised HealthRoster shifts only**; an unfinalised shift, protected or not, is never on it. An **unprotected** waiting shift does not hold the invoice. A **protected** waiting shift **holds the week's invoice** until HealthRoster finalises it or Office unprotects it; unprotect = deemed not worked, the protected pay becomes an overpayment of the difference (never refused), and the week can then be invoiced. A protected shift finalised later is **always added to T0**, which cannot yet be invoiced, and its pay is **netted** against the protected pay already paid, by `candidate_id + work_date + work_event_id` (R-230; within T0's work normally, and across works whenever the shift or T0 lands on another work), never `booking_id`, `segment_id` or Request Id: top-up / overpayment of the difference / nothing. Then the protection clears and the shift becomes invoiceable. A new Timesheet is used **only after issue**: a new shift → new Timesheet and new invoice; changed or removed hours → R0/P0 and a credit note for that Timesheet only (R-240; round 17 item 3 removed the post-authorisation query case). | `03` §26.5 items 1, 3, 6; handoff NX-AI-6 |

original_workgroup_rule_evidence.exact_text: | R-195 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND7_20261012.md | A protected-pay action (Protect pay, Amend, Withdraw/Unprotect, Record not worked, Reconcile / Accept source hours and reconcile, Wait) is allowed for an active user who is EITHER role admin (nothing else needed) OR has payment authoriser OR has golden key, whatever their role; one person, never a second approver; every other operation keeps its current rule. Explicit owner-approved scope exception (all Weekly Source clients, NHSP included), beside R-003 and R-175; replaces admin AND (authoriser OR golden key). Extended by round 8 to every pay-changing action (R-201). | WP-PP §25 |

| R-201 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND8_20261012.md | Every pay-changing action in scope — first Authorise and unauthorise/return of a Weekly Source week, all protected-pay actions, Accept source, Keep as paid, release of a pay hold, the later-change pay decision — uses the predicate active AND (admin OR payment authoriser OR golden key); one person; first Authorise is widened (no stricter check). A non-admin authoriser's Weekly Source/Imports workspace offers every pay-changing action and pay-related query and nothing else (uploads, import/group settings, invoice actions and Checklist confirmations stay admin-only). Weekly Source only (all groups incl. NHSP), plus — because the agency-invoice preset is in this plan's scope — the ordinary authorise/unauthorise, pair authorise, Protect pay and pay-state change of a Timesheet for which the agency-invoice preset predicate is true (`03` §26.3); every other ordinary, Daily and TIMESHEET_AUTHORITY authorisation outside Weekly Source is unchanged here. Extends R-195. Refined by R-234 (round 19): the Checklist is visible to a non-admin authoriser read-only, pay rows only. | WP-PP §25.1 |

| R-216 | owner via coordinator 12/10/2026 (one permission check); rounds 7–8 | The rule active AND (admin OR payment_authoriser OR payment_golden_key) exists once in SQL (`private.weekly_source_pay_actor_allowed_v1`) and once in the Worker (`broker/src/payment-actor-permission.js`); the shared check, the inline SQL sites S2–S10, the widened Worker sites W13–W17 call it; W1–W12 converge through handoff NX-WAIT (they already implement the same predicate and are not edited here; critic R8 item 19); Banking-named copies via handoff NX-WAIT. | `03` §25 |

| R-222 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND15_20261012.md items 2 and 7, and the owner-confirmed reconciliation | The invoiceable Timesheet holds **finalised HealthRoster shifts only**; an unfinalised shift, protected or not, is never on it. An **unprotected** waiting shift does not hold the invoice. A **protected** waiting shift **holds the week's invoice** until HealthRoster finalises it or Office unprotects it; unprotect = deemed not worked, the protected pay becomes an overpayment of the difference (never refused), and the week can then be invoiced. A protected shift finalised later is **always added to T0**, which cannot yet be invoiced, and its pay is **netted** against the protected pay already paid, by `candidate_id + work_date + work_event_id` (R-230; within T0's work normally, and across works whenever the shift or T0 lands on another work), never `booking_id`, `segment_id` or Request Id: top-up / overpayment of the difference / nothing. Then the protection clears and the shift becomes invoiceable. A new Timesheet is used **only after issue**: a new shift → new Timesheet and new invoice; changed or removed hours → R0/P0 and a credit note for that Timesheet only (R-240; round 17 item 3 removed the post-authorisation query case). | `03` §26.5 items 1, 3, 6; handoff NX-AI-6 |

The earlier reject-and-rotate route (extending `candidate_submission_reject_atomic_v1`, `_candidate_timesheet_reject_rotate_v1`, `_candidate_record_capabilities_v1`) is **withdrawn**. Not invoiced → placement `COMPLETE_UNINVOICED_PARENT` (R0 needs no line). Pay nets to the difference. GO-LIVE gate: NEXT nets the chain and keeps the paid revision's snapshot (handoff NX-CHK). | `03` §28.6 |

| R-249 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND22_20261012.md §6 (R22-Q2; binding) | A manager-signed Timesheet on an ISSUED invoice is corrected by a whole reversal plus a manager-signed replacement filled in by the worker in MyTMS, authorised together; a per-Timesheet credit note (round 21); the corrected Timesheet on a new invoice; other workers stay on the original invoice; pay nets to the difference. If the invoice never reached the client, Office may unissue first and it becomes a same-invoice draft round trip with the signed replacement. Built by EXTENDING the whole-correction owner (scope preset or check-only; origin `SIGNED_TIMESHEET_CORRECTION`; P0 at Send, R0 at Authorise both, Cancel correction), the pair-unit arms, the per-Timesheet credit note and the round-trip wrapper. **No route-family successor:** `_candidate_route_family_v1` already returns ELECTRONIC for an ELECTRONIC week snapshot (`24092026_2247…:172-176`); WP-0 proves that the Candidate listing and transition accept the adjustment week. NEXT chain netting NX-AI-3 is extended. | `03` §28.6, §26.6.2, §26.6.3, §25.2 |

| R-250 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND22_20261012.md §7 (R22C-Q1; binding; the critic's recommendation) | The original stays until replaced. In every state (authorised, paid, on a draft, issued), the original signed Timesheet stays current and untouched while a replacement draft waits in MyTMS for the worker to fill in and the manager to sign; nothing (pay, invoice or records) changes until Office authorises the signed replacement together with its reversal; Office has **Cancel correction**, which discards the draft; the paid finance row is never moved or zeroed (Policy X). One mechanism covers every state; it supersedes the reject-and-rotate route of R-248. | `03` §28.6 |

| R-253 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND22_20261012.md §9 (binding) | A reversal/replacement pair is authorised and unauthorised together through BOTH the single and the bulk authorise, starting from either member, with the same result and the same confirmation ("Both timesheets will be authorised together"; button "Authorise both" / "Unauthorise both"); in bulk one member or both is one unit. Reuses the existing expansion (`21072026_1235_00…:435-470`), the single pair flow and the bulk route, with the WHOLE arm for both origins; an unsigned check-only replacement is refused through every entry point. | `03` §28.9, §26.6.2 |

| R-255 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND22_20261012.md §11 (binding; UI critic Q2) | For check-only clients, **Correct this Timesheet** is also used for a manager-signed Timesheet that is **not yet authorised**, in place of today's Reject (state A0). The original stays untouched; at **Authorise both** the original, its reversal and the signed replacement are authorised together in one action, so only the corrected hours count and are paid; placement `COMPLETE_UNINVOICED_PARENT`. Reject of the **hours** is not offered for a signed check-only version, and the Office reject route refuses rejecting its hours (`CONTRACT_HOURS` / `CONTRACT_COMBINED`; `CHECK_ONLY_USE_CORRECT_THIS_TIMESHEET`, a Worker-route guard; the Candidate reject owner is not extended); rejecting an expense claim is unchanged (critic UI R2-5). In A0 the original is never shown as a plain "Authorised" in records or MyTMS, no authorised notification is sent, only the correction item shows while it waits, a lone Authorise of T0 warns, and NEXT pays exactly the replacement with no false overpayment (critic UI R2-4; handoff NX-CHK). | `03` §28.6, §28.9, §27.2 H |

| R-258 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND22_20261012.md §11 (binding; UI critic F15) | A daily correction is designed the same way as the weekly one. For a correction only, the MyTMS daily shift screen (`app/daily/shift.tsx`) shows "We've prefilled this with the corrected hours", highlights the changed times ("Changed: was … · now …"), says "If you think this is wrong, please call the office" and skips "Were these booked hours correct?"; it prefills from replacement draft schedule through existing dailySegments with correction-owned draft/alias/continuation initialization; only changed start/finish/break fields show exact original/proposed deltas; the worker confirms and sends, and the manager signs. **Critic UI R2-2:** the daily replacement's detail carries `daily_shift` frozen from the original booking, so it reaches the daily screen even after the booking has left the Rota window. | `03` §28.6, §27.2 H |

| R-201 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND8_20261012.md | Every pay-changing action in scope — first Authorise and unauthorise/return of a Weekly Source week, all protected-pay actions, Accept source, Keep as paid, release of a pay hold, the later-change pay decision — uses the predicate active AND (admin OR payment authoriser OR golden key); one person; first Authorise is widened (no stricter check). NHSP), plus — because the agency-invoice preset is in this plan's scope — the ordinary authorise/unauthorise, pair authorise, Protect pay and pay-state change of a Timesheet for which the agency-invoice preset predicate is true (`03` §26.3); every other ordinary, Daily and TIMESHEET_AUTHORITY authorisation outside Weekly Source is unchanged here. Extends R-195. Refined by R-234 (round 19): the Checklist is visible to a non-admin authoriser read-only, pay rows only. | WP-PP §25.1 |

| R-216 | owner via coordinator 12/10/2026 (one permission check); rounds 7–8 | The rule active AND (admin OR payment_authoriser OR payment_golden_key) exists once in SQL (`private.weekly_source_pay_actor_allowed_v1`) and once in the Worker (`broker/src/payment-actor-permission.js`); the shared check, the inline SQL sites S2–S10, the widened Worker sites W13–W17 call it; W1–W12 converge through handoff NX-WAIT (they already implement the same predicate and are not edited here; critic R8 item 19); Banking-named copies via handoff NX-WAIT. | `03` §25 |

| R-222 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND15_20261012.md items 2 and 7, and the owner-confirmed reconciliation | The invoiceable Timesheet holds **finalised HealthRoster shifts only**; an unfinalised shift, protected or not, is never on it. An **unprotected** waiting shift does not hold the invoice. A **protected** waiting shift **holds the week's invoice** until HealthRoster finalises it or Office unprotects it; unprotect = deemed not worked, the protected pay becomes an overpayment of the difference (never refused), and the week can then be invoiced. A protected shift finalised later is **always added to T0**, which cannot yet be invoiced, and its pay is **netted** against the protected pay already paid, by `candidate_id + work_date + work_event_id` (R-230; within T0's work normally, and across works whenever the shift or T0 lands on another work), never `booking_id`, `segment_id` or Request Id: top-up / overpayment of the difference / nothing. Then the protection clears and the shift becomes invoiceable. A new Timesheet is used **only after issue**: a new shift → new Timesheet and new invoice; changed or removed hours → R0/P0 and a credit note for that Timesheet only (R-240; round 17 item 3 removed the post-authorisation query case). | `03` §26.5 items 1, 3, 6; handoff NX-AI-6 |

original_workgroup_rule_evidence.exact_text: | R-195 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND7_20261012.md | A protected-pay action (Protect pay, Amend, Withdraw/Unprotect, Record not worked, Reconcile / Accept source hours and reconcile, Wait) is allowed for an active user who is EITHER role admin (nothing else needed) OR has payment authoriser OR has golden key, whatever their role; one person, never a second approver; every other operation keeps its current rule. Explicit owner-approved scope exception (all Weekly Source clients, NHSP included), beside R-003 and R-175; replaces admin AND (authoriser OR golden key). Extended by round 8 to every pay-changing action (R-201). | WP-PP §25 |

| R-201 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND8_20261012.md | Every pay-changing action in scope — first Authorise and unauthorise/return of a Weekly Source week, all protected-pay actions, Accept source, Keep as paid, release of a pay hold, the later-change pay decision — uses the predicate active AND (admin OR payment authoriser OR golden key); one person; first Authorise is widened (no stricter check). A non-admin authoriser's Weekly Source/Imports workspace offers every pay-changing action and pay-related query and nothing else (uploads, import/group settings, invoice actions and Checklist confirmations stay admin-only). Weekly Source only (all groups incl. NHSP), plus — because the agency-invoice preset is in this plan's scope — the ordinary authorise/unauthorise, pair authorise, Protect pay and pay-state change of a Timesheet for which the agency-invoice preset predicate is true (`03` §26.3); every other ordinary, Daily and TIMESHEET_AUTHORITY authorisation outside Weekly Source is unchanged here. Extends R-195. Refined by R-234 (round 19): the Checklist is visible to a non-admin authoriser read-only, pay rows only. | WP-PP §25.1 |

| R-216 | owner via coordinator 12/10/2026 (one permission check); rounds 7–8 | The rule active AND (admin OR payment_authoriser OR payment_golden_key) exists once in SQL (`private.weekly_source_pay_actor_allowed_v1`) and once in the Worker (`broker/src/payment-actor-permission.js`); the shared check, the inline SQL sites S2–S10, the widened Worker sites W13–W17 call it; W1–W12 converge through handoff NX-WAIT (they already implement the same predicate and are not edited here; critic R8 item 19); Banking-named copies via handoff NX-WAIT. | `03` §25 |

| R-222 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND15_20261012.md items 2 and 7, and the owner-confirmed reconciliation | The invoiceable Timesheet holds **finalised HealthRoster shifts only**; an unfinalised shift, protected or not, is never on it. An **unprotected** waiting shift does not hold the invoice. A **protected** waiting shift **holds the week's invoice** until HealthRoster finalises it or Office unprotects it; unprotect = deemed not worked, the protected pay becomes an overpayment of the difference (never refused), and the week can then be invoiced. A protected shift finalised later is **always added to T0**, which cannot yet be invoiced, and its pay is **netted** against the protected pay already paid, by `candidate_id + work_date + work_event_id` (R-230; within T0's work normally, and across works whenever the shift or T0 lands on another work), never `booking_id`, `segment_id` or Request Id: top-up / overpayment of the difference / nothing. Then the protection clears and the shift becomes invoiceable. A new Timesheet is used **only after issue**: a new shift → new Timesheet and new invoice; changed or removed hours → R0/P0 and a credit note for that Timesheet only (R-240; round 17 item 3 removed the post-authorisation query case). | `03` §26.5 items 1, 3, 6; handoff NX-AI-6 |

Supersedes the round-5 "turns red". | §24.8, §10 |

| R-195 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND7_20261012.md | A protected-pay action (Protect pay, Amend, Withdraw/Unprotect, Record not worked, Reconcile / Accept source hours and reconcile, Wait) is allowed for an active user who is EITHER role admin (nothing else needed) OR has payment authoriser OR has golden key, whatever their role; one person, never a second approver; every other operation keeps its current rule. Extended by round 8 to every pay-changing action (R-201). | WP-PP §25 |

Weekly Source only (all groups incl. NHSP), plus — because the agency-invoice preset is in this plan's scope — the ordinary authorise/unauthorise, pair authorise, Protect pay and pay-state change of a Timesheet for which the agency-invoice preset predicate is true (`03` §26.3); every other ordinary, Daily and TIMESHEET_AUTHORITY authorisation outside Weekly Source is unchanged here. NEXT collectable overpayment (Weekly Source/protected FC-15 and ordinary PAYE + Umbrella/non-PAYE G5) is a GO-LIVE prerequisite; until collection exists NEXT must still record the overpayment for manual collection and never drop it. | all presets; handoff NX-REC |
