| R-021 | 11/10/2026 owner via coordinator ruling 10 | Workers are paid finalised source hours, or protected pay pre-filled from the worker-signed MyTMS submission; protect, reconcile, unprotect. For Acacium, finalised source hours are paid only once the shift is on the accepted Acacium report, or when protected (R-176). | WP-F7, P |

| R-178 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND6_20261012.md FE-M02 / N-M04 | "✗ Holds pay" appears only when a real, scoped amount is actually withheld from the worker; an Office decision that withholds nothing shows amber "! Decision needed" with the choice in the sub-line; approved or already-paid money is kept until Office decides; "✗ Holds invoice" stays red where the invoice genuinely cannot be created. Supersedes the round-5 "turns red". | §24.8, §10 |

| R-195 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND7_20261012.md | A protected-pay action (Protect pay, Amend, Withdraw/Unprotect, Record not worked, Reconcile / Accept source hours and reconcile, Wait) is allowed for an active user who is EITHER role admin (nothing else needed) OR has payment authoriser OR has golden key, whatever their role; one person, never a second approver; every other operation keeps its current rule. Explicit owner-approved scope exception (all Weekly Source clients, NHSP included), beside R-003 and R-175; replaces admin AND (authoriser OR golden key). Extended by round 8 to every pay-changing action (R-201). | WP-PP §25 |

| R-201 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND8_20261012.md | Every pay-changing action in scope — first Authorise and unauthorise/return of a Weekly Source week, all protected-pay actions, Accept source, Keep as paid, release of a pay hold, the later-change pay decision — uses the predicate active AND (admin OR payment authoriser OR golden key); one person; first Authorise is widened (no stricter check). A non-admin authoriser's Weekly Source/Imports workspace offers every pay-changing action and pay-related query and nothing else (uploads, import/group settings, invoice actions and Checklist confirmations stay admin-only). Weekly Source only (all groups incl. NHSP), plus — because the agency-invoice preset is in this plan's scope — the ordinary authorise/unauthorise, pair authorise, Protect pay and pay-state change of a Timesheet for which the agency-invoice preset predicate is true (`03` §26.3); every other ordinary, Daily and TIMESHEET_AUTHORITY authorisation outside Weekly Source is unchanged here. Extends R-195. Refined by R-234 (round 19): the Checklist is visible to a non-admin authoriser read-only, pay rows only. | WP-PP §25.1 |

| R-213 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND12_20261012.md (owner correction, all presets) | A decrease after payment is **never refused**, in every preset: unprotect, protected hours amended down, source hours down, a removed shift after Accept source, and a whole reversal/replacement each create an **overpayment of the net difference only** in the overpayment system, never a full-amount debt. NEXT collectable overpayment (Weekly Source/protected FC-15 and ordinary PAYE + Umbrella/non-PAYE G5) is a GO-LIVE prerequisite; until collection exists NEXT must still record the overpayment for manual collection and never drop it. | all presets; handoff NX-REC |

| R-216 | owner via coordinator 12/10/2026 (one permission check); rounds 7–8 | The rule active AND (admin OR payment_authoriser OR payment_golden_key) exists once in SQL (`private.weekly_source_pay_actor_allowed_v1`) and once in the Worker (`broker/src/payment-actor-permission.js`); the shared check, the inline SQL sites S2–S10, the widened Worker sites W13–W17 call it; W1–W12 converge through handoff NX-WAIT (they already implement the same predicate and are not edited here; critic R8 item 19); Banking-named copies via handoff NX-WAIT. | `03` §25 |

| R-217 | Plan 6.2 CALL-ONLY boundary; round-5 critic M2 (adopted) | The hash-pinned owners `timesheet_authorise_generic_atomic` and `timesheet_unauthorise_atomic` (pinned by `supabase/verification/17092026_0610_weekly_source_withdrawal_supersession_v1.sql:1142-1160`) are never edited: the preset works through thin wrappers beside them (existing `tsfin_update_segments_locked` then the unchanged owner); if that proves impossible the build stops and reports under `07` §4 naming that verifier. No unauthorise successor is built. | `03` §26.5 item 4, §26.6.4 |

| R-218 | round-5 critic M4; ROUND14 item 2 (rewritten) | Protect, Amend and Unprotect change pay only, by the difference, on the protected-pay position (except a protected shift finalised at different hours, which has only Accept HealthRoster hours or Wait, R-227): no T0 edit, no unauthorise, no R0/P0, no invoice line effect (Unprotect of a still-waiting shift releases the week's invoice hold, R-222); replay-safe by request key. A **T0** change (alignment, a finalised-later shift on an uninvoiced T0) runs as one Office action: edit → Worker recalculation → authorise wrapper only when the TSFIN is fresh, so pay is never half-changed; for an already authorised T0 the system unauthorises and amends, and Office re-authorises through the normal route (R-202). | `03` §26.5 items 1, 3, 5 |

Explicit owner-approved scope exception (all Weekly Source clients, NHSP included), beside R-003 and R-175; replaces admin AND (authoriser OR golden key). Extended by round 8 to every pay-changing action (R-201). | WP-PP §25 |

| R-201 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND8_20261012.md | Every pay-changing action in scope — first Authorise and unauthorise/return of a Weekly Source week, all protected-pay actions, Accept source, Keep as paid, release of a pay hold, the later-change pay decision — uses the predicate active AND (admin OR payment authoriser OR golden key); one person; first Authorise is widened (no stricter check). A non-admin authoriser's Weekly Source/Imports workspace offers every pay-changing action and pay-related query and nothing else (uploads, import/group settings, invoice actions and Checklist confirmations stay admin-only). Weekly Source only (all groups incl. NHSP), plus — because the agency-invoice preset is in this plan's scope — the ordinary authorise/unauthorise, pair authorise, Protect pay and pay-state change of a Timesheet for which the agency-invoice preset predicate is true (`03` §26.3); every other ordinary, Daily and TIMESHEET_AUTHORITY authorisation outside Weekly Source is unchanged here. Extends R-195. Refined by R-234 (round 19): the Checklist is visible to a non-admin authoriser read-only, pay rows only. | WP-PP §25.1 |

| R-216 | owner via coordinator 12/10/2026 (one permission check); rounds 7–8 | The rule active AND (admin OR payment_authoriser OR payment_golden_key) exists once in SQL (`private.weekly_source_pay_actor_allowed_v1`) and once in the Worker (`broker/src/payment-actor-permission.js`); the shared check, the inline SQL sites S2–S10, the widened Worker sites W13–W17 call it; W1–W12 converge through handoff NX-WAIT (they already implement the same predicate and are not edited here; critic R8 item 19); Banking-named copies via handoff NX-WAIT. | `03` §25 |

| R-222 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND15_20261012.md items 2 and 7, and the owner-confirmed reconciliation | The invoiceable Timesheet holds **finalised HealthRoster shifts only**; an unfinalised shift, protected or not, is never on it. An **unprotected** waiting shift does not hold the invoice. A **protected** waiting shift **holds the week's invoice** until HealthRoster finalises it or Office unprotects it; unprotect = deemed not worked, the protected pay becomes an overpayment of the difference (never refused), and the week can then be invoiced. A protected shift finalised later is **always added to T0**, which cannot yet be invoiced, and its pay is **netted** against the protected pay already paid, by `candidate_id + work_date + work_event_id` (R-230; within T0's work normally, and across works whenever the shift or T0 lands on another work), never `booking_id`, `segment_id` or Request Id: top-up / overpayment of the difference / nothing. Then the protection clears and the shift becomes invoiceable. A new Timesheet is used **only after issue**: a new shift → new Timesheet and new invoice; changed or removed hours → R0/P0 and a credit note for that Timesheet only (R-240; round 17 item 3 removed the post-authorisation query case). | `03` §26.5 items 1, 3, 6; handoff NX-AI-6 |

original_workgroup_rule_evidence.exact_text: | R-239 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND20_20261012.md R8-Q1 (binding) | An active admin, payment authoriser or golden-key holder may run the one-click unissued-draft round trip (remove the Timesheet from the draft, amend, return it to the SAME draft) for that Timesheet only, through one narrow service-only wrapper. The wrapper builds only `remove_invoice_line_ids` for that Timesheet's lines and `add_timesheet_ids` for its return to the same draft, and checks the shared pay-change predicate. All other invoice editing, `invoice_apply_edits` in general included, stays admin-only. **Codex R2 C02:** the invoice editor is unchanged (its admin check applies only on the non-service branch); every guard sits in the wrapper and the authorised Worker route, proved through the real Worker → PostgREST → wrapper path, with interruption recovery (DA-6). | `03` §25.2, §26.5 item 5 |

| R-240 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND21_20261012.md (binding; supersedes the round-11 whole-invoice reading) | After an invoice I1 is ISSUED and a worker's hours on it are amended or a shift removed: I1 is never edited; every other worker's Timesheet stays on I1, not credited and not re-invoiced; the affected Timesheet T0 is reversed in full by R0; the credit note is made from R0 (T0's lines only, linked to R0 — see the representation clause — value exactly −T0 on I1, `original_invoice_id` = I1), so R0's invoice home is the credit note; P0 carries the full corrected week on a new invoice, or, when no shift remains, is empty with no line and the credit note alone completes the correction. R0 and P0 are authorised together (R-205/R-214); pay nets to the difference (R-205); a new shift after issue needs no credit note; before issue the same-draft round trip applies (R-202/R-239); automatic Batch Generate, no Office button (R-203/R-228). Built as an optional `credit_scope` on the existing GENERATE_CREDIT_NOTE start core, resolver and advance; no parallel pipeline. **Representation (critic R21 M4):** R0 is placed on the credit note by being linked to it (`meta_json.reversal_timesheet_id` on every credit line) and locked to it (R0's TSFIN lock to CN), with value exactly −T0; the credit lines keep T0's `timesheet_id`, so the document shows T0's worker, week and hours with minus amounts. The owner's ruling stands; this is the representation only. I1 is never written (no mark); a second correction credits the record it reverses (`reversed_timesheet_id`) on that record's invoice. **Codex disposition R21-REP:** the independent review's suggestion to put R0 as the credit lines' `timesheet_id` is not adopted; this representation wins (T0 on the credit lines, R0 in `meta_json`). **Round-21 proof gates P-2…P-9, P-14 (`03` §26.6.2, §26.6.3):** completion only once the CN is issued; multi-line placement; the I1 overlap lock; own-operation resume; the legacy writers fenced; numbering; the issue child; no unissue of I1 under a credit. | `03` §26.6 |

original_workgroup_rule_evidence.exact_text: | R-239 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND20_20261012.md R8-Q1 (binding) | An active admin, payment authoriser or golden-key holder may run the one-click unissued-draft round trip (remove the Timesheet from the draft, amend, return it to the SAME draft) for that Timesheet only, through one narrow service-only wrapper. The wrapper builds only `remove_invoice_line_ids` for that Timesheet's lines and `add_timesheet_ids` for its return to the same draft, and checks the shared pay-change predicate. All other invoice editing, `invoice_apply_edits` in general included, stays admin-only. **Codex R2 C02:** the invoice editor is unchanged (its admin check applies only on the non-service branch); every guard sits in the wrapper and the authorised Worker route, proved through the real Worker → PostgREST → wrapper path, with interruption recovery (DA-6). | `03` §25.2, §26.5 item 5 |

| R-240 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND21_20261012.md (binding; supersedes the round-11 whole-invoice reading) | After an invoice I1 is ISSUED and a worker's hours on it are amended or a shift removed: I1 is never edited; every other worker's Timesheet stays on I1, not credited and not re-invoiced; the affected Timesheet T0 is reversed in full by R0; the credit note is made from R0 (T0's lines only, linked to R0 — see the representation clause — value exactly −T0 on I1, `original_invoice_id` = I1), so R0's invoice home is the credit note; P0 carries the full corrected week on a new invoice, or, when no shift remains, is empty with no line and the credit note alone completes the correction. R0 and P0 are authorised together (R-205/R-214); pay nets to the difference (R-205); a new shift after issue needs no credit note; before issue the same-draft round trip applies (R-202/R-239); automatic Batch Generate, no Office button (R-203/R-228). Built as an optional `credit_scope` on the existing GENERATE_CREDIT_NOTE start core, resolver and advance; no parallel pipeline. **Representation (critic R21 M4):** R0 is placed on the credit note by being linked to it (`meta_json.reversal_timesheet_id` on every credit line) and locked to it (R0's TSFIN lock to CN), with value exactly −T0; the credit lines keep T0's `timesheet_id`, so the document shows T0's worker, week and hours with minus amounts. The owner's ruling stands; this is the representation only. I1 is never written (no mark); a second correction credits the record it reverses (`reversed_timesheet_id`) on that record's invoice. **Codex disposition R21-REP:** the independent review's suggestion to put R0 as the credit lines' `timesheet_id` is not adopted; this representation wins (T0 on the credit lines, R0 in `meta_json`). **Round-21 proof gates P-2…P-9, P-14 (`03` §26.6.2, §26.6.3):** completion only once the CN is issued; multi-line placement; the I1 overlap lock; own-operation resume; the legacy writers fenced; numbering; the issue child; no unissue of I1 under a credit. | `03` §26.6 |

original_workgroup_rule_evidence.exact_text: | R-239 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND20_20261012.md R8-Q1 (binding) | An active admin, payment authoriser or golden-key holder may run the one-click unissued-draft round trip (remove the Timesheet from the draft, amend, return it to the SAME draft) for that Timesheet only, through one narrow service-only wrapper. The wrapper builds only `remove_invoice_line_ids` for that Timesheet's lines and `add_timesheet_ids` for its return to the same draft, and checks the shared pay-change predicate. All other invoice editing, `invoice_apply_edits` in general included, stays admin-only. **Codex R2 C02:** the invoice editor is unchanged (its admin check applies only on the non-service branch); every guard sits in the wrapper and the authorised Worker route, proved through the real Worker → PostgREST → wrapper path, with interruption recovery (DA-6). | `03` §25.2, §26.5 item 5 |

| R-240 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND21_20261012.md (binding; supersedes the round-11 whole-invoice reading) | After an invoice I1 is ISSUED and a worker's hours on it are amended or a shift removed: I1 is never edited; every other worker's Timesheet stays on I1, not credited and not re-invoiced; the affected Timesheet T0 is reversed in full by R0; the credit note is made from R0 (T0's lines only, linked to R0 — see the representation clause — value exactly −T0 on I1, `original_invoice_id` = I1), so R0's invoice home is the credit note; P0 carries the full corrected week on a new invoice, or, when no shift remains, is empty with no line and the credit note alone completes the correction. R0 and P0 are authorised together (R-205/R-214); pay nets to the difference (R-205); a new shift after issue needs no credit note; before issue the same-draft round trip applies (R-202/R-239); automatic Batch Generate, no Office button (R-203/R-228). Built as an optional `credit_scope` on the existing GENERATE_CREDIT_NOTE start core, resolver and advance; no parallel pipeline. **Representation (critic R21 M4):** R0 is placed on the credit note by being linked to it (`meta_json.reversal_timesheet_id` on every credit line) and locked to it (R0's TSFIN lock to CN), with value exactly −T0; the credit lines keep T0's `timesheet_id`, so the document shows T0's worker, week and hours with minus amounts. The owner's ruling stands; this is the representation only. I1 is never written (no mark); a second correction credits the record it reverses (`reversed_timesheet_id`) on that record's invoice. **Codex disposition R21-REP:** the independent review's suggestion to put R0 as the credit lines' `timesheet_id` is not adopted; this representation wins (T0 on the credit lines, R0 in `meta_json`). **Round-21 proof gates P-2…P-9, P-14 (`03` §26.6.2, §26.6.3):** completion only once the CN is issued; multi-line placement; the I1 overlap lock; own-operation resume; the legacy writers fenced; numbering; the issue child; no unissue of I1 under a credit. | `03` §26.6 |

original_workgroup_rule_evidence.exact_text: | R-239 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND20_20261012.md R8-Q1 (binding) | An active admin, payment authoriser or golden-key holder may run the one-click unissued-draft round trip (remove the Timesheet from the draft, amend, return it to the SAME draft) for that Timesheet only, through one narrow service-only wrapper. The wrapper builds only `remove_invoice_line_ids` for that Timesheet's lines and `add_timesheet_ids` for its return to the same draft, and checks the shared pay-change predicate. All other invoice editing, `invoice_apply_edits` in general included, stays admin-only. **Codex R2 C02:** the invoice editor is unchanged (its admin check applies only on the non-service branch); every guard sits in the wrapper and the authorised Worker route, proved through the real Worker → PostgREST → wrapper path, with interruption recovery (DA-6). | `03` §25.2, §26.5 item 5 |

| R-240 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND21_20261012.md (binding; supersedes the round-11 whole-invoice reading) | After an invoice I1 is ISSUED and a worker's hours on it are amended or a shift removed: I1 is never edited; every other worker's Timesheet stays on I1, not credited and not re-invoiced; the affected Timesheet T0 is reversed in full by R0; the credit note is made from R0 (T0's lines only, linked to R0 — see the representation clause — value exactly −T0 on I1, `original_invoice_id` = I1), so R0's invoice home is the credit note; P0 carries the full corrected week on a new invoice, or, when no shift remains, is empty with no line and the credit note alone completes the correction. R0 and P0 are authorised together (R-205/R-214); pay nets to the difference (R-205); a new shift after issue needs no credit note; before issue the same-draft round trip applies (R-202/R-239); automatic Batch Generate, no Office button (R-203/R-228). Built as an optional `credit_scope` on the existing GENERATE_CREDIT_NOTE start core, resolver and advance; no parallel pipeline. **Representation (critic R21 M4):** R0 is placed on the credit note by being linked to it (`meta_json.reversal_timesheet_id` on every credit line) and locked to it (R0's TSFIN lock to CN), with value exactly −T0; the credit lines keep T0's `timesheet_id`, so the document shows T0's worker, week and hours with minus amounts. The owner's ruling stands; this is the representation only. I1 is never written (no mark); a second correction credits the record it reverses (`reversed_timesheet_id`) on that record's invoice. **Codex disposition R21-REP:** the independent review's suggestion to put R0 as the credit lines' `timesheet_id` is not adopted; this representation wins (T0 on the credit lines, R0 in `meta_json`). **Round-21 proof gates P-2…P-9, P-14 (`03` §26.6.2, §26.6.3):** completion only once the CN is issued; multi-line placement; the I1 overlap lock; own-operation resume; the legacy writers fenced; numbering; the issue child; no unissue of I1 under a credit. | `03` §26.6 |

GO-LIVE gate: NEXT nets the chain and keeps the paid revision's snapshot (handoff NX-CHK). | `03` §28.6 |

NEXT chain netting NX-AI-3 is extended. | `03` §28.6, §26.6.2, §26.6.3, §25.2 |

| R-250 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND22_20261012.md §7 (R22C-Q1; binding; the critic's recommendation) | The original stays until replaced. In every state (authorised, paid, on a draft, issued), the original signed Timesheet stays current and untouched while a replacement draft waits in MyTMS for the worker to fill in and the manager to sign; nothing (pay, invoice or records) changes until Office authorises the signed replacement together with its reversal; Office has **Cancel correction**, which discards the draft; the paid finance row is never moved or zeroed (Policy X). One mechanism covers every state; it supersedes the reject-and-rotate route of R-248. | `03` §28.6 |

| R-253 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND22_20261012.md §9 (binding) | A reversal/replacement pair is authorised and unauthorised together through BOTH the single and the bulk authorise, starting from either member, with the same result and the same confirmation ("Both timesheets will be authorised together"; button "Authorise both" / "Unauthorise both"); in bulk one member or both is one unit. Reuses the existing expansion (`21072026_1235_00…:435-470`), the single pair flow and the bulk route, with the WHOLE arm for both origins; an unsigned check-only replacement is refused through every entry point. | `03` §28.9, §26.6.2 |

| R-255 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND22_20261012.md §11 (binding; UI critic Q2) | For check-only clients, **Correct this Timesheet** is also used for a manager-signed Timesheet that is **not yet authorised**, in place of today's Reject (state A0). The original stays untouched; at **Authorise both** the original, its reversal and the signed replacement are authorised together in one action, so only the corrected hours count and are paid; placement `COMPLETE_UNINVOICED_PARENT`. Reject of the **hours** is not offered for a signed check-only version, and the Office reject route refuses rejecting its hours (`CONTRACT_HOURS` / `CONTRACT_COMBINED`; `CHECK_ONLY_USE_CORRECT_THIS_TIMESHEET`, a Worker-route guard; the Candidate reject owner is not extended); rejecting an expense claim is unchanged (critic UI R2-5). | R-258 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND22_20261012.md §11 (binding; UI critic F15) | A daily correction is designed the same way as the weekly one. In every state (authorised, paid, on a draft, issued), the original signed Timesheet stays current and untouched while a replacement draft waits in MyTMS for the worker to fill in and the manager to sign; nothing (pay, invoice or records) changes until Office authorises the signed replacement together with its reversal; Office has **Cancel correction**, which discards the draft; the paid finance row is never moved or zeroed (Policy X). One mechanism covers every state; it supersedes the reject-and-rotate route of R-248. | `03` §28.6 |

| R-253 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND22_20261012.md §9 (binding) | A reversal/replacement pair is authorised and unauthorised together through BOTH the single and the bulk authorise, starting from either member, with the same result and the same confirmation ("Both timesheets will be authorised together"; button "Authorise both" / "Unauthorise both"); in bulk one member or both is one unit. Reuses the existing expansion (`21072026_1235_00…:435-470`), the single pair flow and the bulk route, with the WHOLE arm for both origins; an unsigned check-only replacement is refused through every entry point. | `03` §28.9, §26.6.2 |

The original stays untouched; at **Authorise both** the original, its reversal and the signed replacement are authorised together in one action, so only the corrected hours count and are paid; placement `COMPLETE_UNINVOICED_PARENT`. Reject of the **hours** is not offered for a signed check-only version, and the Office reject route refuses rejecting its hours (`CONTRACT_HOURS` / `CONTRACT_COMBINED`; `CHECK_ONLY_USE_CORRECT_THIS_TIMESHEET`, a Worker-route guard; the Candidate reject owner is not extended); rejecting an expense claim is unchanged (critic UI R2-5). In every state (authorised, paid, on a draft, issued), the original signed Timesheet stays current and untouched while a replacement draft waits in MyTMS for the worker to fill in and the manager to sign; nothing (pay, invoice or records) changes until Office authorises the signed replacement together with its reversal; Office has **Cancel correction**, which discards the draft; the paid finance row is never moved or zeroed (Policy X). GO-LIVE gate: NEXT nets the chain and keeps the paid revision's snapshot (handoff NX-CHK). | `03` §28.6 |

If the invoice never reached the client, Office may unissue first and it becomes a same-invoice draft round trip with the signed replacement. Built by EXTENDING the whole-correction owner (scope preset or check-only; origin `SIGNED_TIMESHEET_CORRECTION`; P0 at Send, R0 at Authorise both, Cancel correction), the pair-unit arms, the per-Timesheet credit note and the round-trip wrapper. **No route-family successor:** `_candidate_route_family_v1` already returns ELECTRONIC for an ELECTRONIC week snapshot (`24092026_2247…:172-176`); WP-0 proves that the Candidate listing and transition accept the adjustment week. NEXT chain netting NX-AI-3 is extended. | `03` §28.6, §26.6.2, §26.6.3, §25.2 |

| R-250 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND22_20261012.md §7 (R22C-Q1; binding; the critic's recommendation) | The original stays until replaced. In every state (authorised, paid, on a draft, issued), the original signed Timesheet stays current and untouched while a replacement draft waits in MyTMS for the worker to fill in and the manager to sign; nothing (pay, invoice or records) changes until Office authorises the signed replacement together with its reversal; Office has **Cancel correction**, which discards the draft; the paid finance row is never moved or zeroed (Policy X). One mechanism covers every state; it supersedes the reject-and-rotate route of R-248. | `03` §28.6 |

| R-253 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND22_20261012.md §9 (binding) | A reversal/replacement pair is authorised and unauthorised together through BOTH the single and the bulk authorise, starting from either member, with the same result and the same confirmation ("Both timesheets will be authorised together"; button "Authorise both" / "Unauthorise both"); in bulk one member or both is one unit. Reuses the existing expansion (`21072026_1235_00…:435-470`), the single pair flow and the bulk route, with the WHOLE arm for both origins; an unsigned check-only replacement is refused through every entry point. | `03` §28.9, §26.6.2 |

| R-255 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND22_20261012.md §11 (binding; UI critic Q2) | For check-only clients, **Correct this Timesheet** is also used for a manager-signed Timesheet that is **not yet authorised**, in place of today's Reject (state A0). The original stays untouched; at **Authorise both** the original, its reversal and the signed replacement are authorised together in one action, so only the corrected hours count and are paid; placement `COMPLETE_UNINVOICED_PARENT`. Reject of the **hours** is not offered for a signed check-only version, and the Office reject route refuses rejecting its hours (`CONTRACT_HOURS` / `CONTRACT_COMBINED`; `CHECK_ONLY_USE_CORRECT_THIS_TIMESHEET`, a Worker-route guard; the Candidate reject owner is not extended); rejecting an expense claim is unchanged (critic UI R2-5). | R-258 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND22_20261012.md §11 (binding; UI critic F15) | A daily correction is designed the same way as the weekly one. A **T0** change (alignment, a finalised-later shift on an uninvoiced T0) runs as one Office action: edit → Worker recalculation → authorise wrapper only when the TSFIN is fresh, so pay is never half-changed; for an already authorised T0 the system unauthorises and amends, and Office re-authorises through the normal route (R-202). | `03` §26.5 items 1, 3, 5 |

There is **no** Office "accept as checked" override. If HealthRoster is never corrected, the worker withdraws the claim in MyTMS and resubmits a new manager-signed Timesheet, which is checked again. Verified: this works today for an unpaid Timesheet (Office unauthorises, then rejects or the worker withdraws); for a paid one through R-248 (option B1) and for an invoiced one through R-249. | `03` §28.5, §28.6 |

| R-245 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND22_20261012.md §4 (binding) | For check-only clients pay does not wait; invoicing does. The worker is paid from the signed Timesheet on authorisation (NEXT reads no HealthRoster state) while the invoice waits (`READY_FOR_HR` / `HR_VALIDATION_BLOCKED`). The old pay-path hold is irrelevant under NEXT; handoff NX-CHK asks Banking Pay to confirm NEXT never gates pay on it. | `03` §28.5; handoff NX-CHK |

| R-248 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND22_20261012.md §6 (R22-Q1; binding), re-derived by R-250 | A paid but not-invoiced manager-signed Timesheet of a check-only client is corrected through Office's **Correct this Timesheet**. **HARD RULE (every state):** the replacement must itself be a manager-signed Timesheet with the new hours (the worker enters them in MyTMS, the manager signs); Office never types or edits signed hours (a guard beside `contract_week_manual_upsert_atomic`, `CHECK_ONLY_SIGNED_HOURS_OFFICE_EDIT_REFUSED`) and never authorises an unsigned replacement (Worker route plus deferred trigger, `CHECK_ONLY_REPLACEMENT_NOT_SIGNED`). **Since R-250** it uses the same mechanism as R-249: the original stays current and untouched; a replacement P0 waits in MyTMS; R0 and the signed P0 are authorised together; Cancel correction discards P0; the paid finance row is never moved or zeroed. The earlier reject-and-rotate route (extending `candidate_submission_reject_atomic_v1`, `_candidate_timesheet_reject_rotate_v1`, `_candidate_record_capabilities_v1`) is **withdrawn**. Not invoiced → placement `COMPLETE_UNINVOICED_PARENT` (R0 needs no line). Pay nets to the difference. GO-LIVE gate: NEXT nets the chain and keeps the paid revision's snapshot (handoff NX-CHK). | `03` §28.6 |

| R-249 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND22_20261012.md §6 (R22-Q2; binding) | A manager-signed Timesheet on an ISSUED invoice is corrected by a whole reversal plus a manager-signed replacement filled in by the worker in MyTMS, authorised together; a per-Timesheet credit note (round 21); the corrected Timesheet on a new invoice; other workers stay on the original invoice; pay nets to the difference. If the invoice never reached the client, Office may unissue first and it becomes a same-invoice draft round trip with the signed replacement. Built by EXTENDING the whole-correction owner (scope preset or check-only; origin `SIGNED_TIMESHEET_CORRECTION`; P0 at Send, R0 at Authorise both, Cancel correction), the pair-unit arms, the per-Timesheet credit note and the round-trip wrapper. **No route-family successor:** `_candidate_route_family_v1` already returns ELECTRONIC for an ELECTRONIC week snapshot (`24092026_2247…:172-176`); WP-0 proves that the Candidate listing and transition accept the adjustment week. NEXT chain netting NX-AI-3 is extended. | `03` §28.6, §26.6.2, §26.6.3, §25.2 |

| R-250 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND22_20261012.md §7 (R22C-Q1; binding; the critic's recommendation) | The original stays until replaced. In every state (authorised, paid, on a draft, issued), the original signed Timesheet stays current and untouched while a replacement draft waits in MyTMS for the worker to fill in and the manager to sign; nothing (pay, invoice or records) changes until Office authorises the signed replacement together with its reversal; Office has **Cancel correction**, which discards the draft; the paid finance row is never moved or zeroed (Policy X). One mechanism covers every state; it supersedes the reject-and-rotate route of R-248. | `03` §28.6 |

| R-253 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND22_20261012.md §9 (binding) | A reversal/replacement pair is authorised and unauthorised together through BOTH the single and the bulk authorise, starting from either member, with the same result and the same confirmation ("Both timesheets will be authorised together"; button "Authorise both" / "Unauthorise both"); in bulk one member or both is one unit. Reuses the existing expansion (`21072026_1235_00…:435-470`), the single pair flow and the bulk route, with the WHOLE arm for both origins; an unsigned check-only replacement is refused through every entry point. | `03` §28.9, §26.6.2 |

| R-255 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND22_20261012.md §11 (binding; UI critic Q2) | For check-only clients, **Correct this Timesheet** is also used for a manager-signed Timesheet that is **not yet authorised**, in place of today's Reject (state A0). The original stays untouched; at **Authorise both** the original, its reversal and the signed replacement are authorised together in one action, so only the corrected hours count and are paid; placement `COMPLETE_UNINVOICED_PARENT`. Reject of the **hours** is not offered for a signed check-only version, and the Office reject route refuses rejecting its hours (`CONTRACT_HOURS` / `CONTRACT_COMBINED`; `CHECK_ONLY_USE_CORRECT_THIS_TIMESHEET`, a Worker-route guard; the Candidate reject owner is not extended); rejecting an expense claim is unchanged (critic UI R2-5). In A0 the original is never shown as a plain "Authorised" in records or MyTMS, no authorised notification is sent, only the correction item shows while it waits, a lone Authorise of T0 warns, and NEXT pays exactly the replacement with no false overpayment (critic UI R2-4; handoff NX-CHK). | `03` §28.6, §28.9, §27.2 H |

| R-258 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND22_20261012.md §11 (binding; UI critic F15) | A daily correction is designed the same way as the weekly one. For a correction only, the MyTMS daily shift screen (`app/daily/shift.tsx`) shows "We've prefilled this with the corrected hours", highlights the changed times ("Changed: was … · now …"), says "If you think this is wrong, please call the office" and skips "Were these booked hours correct?"; it prefills from replacement draft schedule through existing dailySegments with correction-owned draft/alias/continuation initialization; only changed start/finish/break fields show exact original/proposed deltas; the worker confirms and sends, and the manager signs. **Critic UI R2-2:** the daily replacement's detail carries `daily_shift` frozen from the original booking, so it reaches the daily screen even after the booking has left the Rota window. | `03` §28.6, §27.2 H |

A **T0** change (alignment, a finalised-later shift on an uninvoiced T0) runs as one Office action: edit → Worker recalculation → authorise wrapper only when the TSFIN is fresh, so pay is never half-changed; for an already authorised T0 the system unauthorises and amends, and Office re-authorises through the normal route (R-202). | `03` §26.5 items 1, 3, 5 |

There is **no** Office "accept as checked" override. If HealthRoster is never corrected, the worker withdraws the claim in MyTMS and resubmits a new manager-signed Timesheet, which is checked again. Verified: this works today for an unpaid Timesheet (Office unauthorises, then rejects or the worker withdraws); for a paid one through R-248 (option B1) and for an invoiced one through R-249. | `03` §28.5, §28.6 |

| R-245 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND22_20261012.md §4 (binding) | For check-only clients pay does not wait; invoicing does. The worker is paid from the signed Timesheet on authorisation (NEXT reads no HealthRoster state) while the invoice waits (`READY_FOR_HR` / `HR_VALIDATION_BLOCKED`). The old pay-path hold is irrelevant under NEXT; handoff NX-CHK asks Banking Pay to confirm NEXT never gates pay on it. | `03` §28.5; handoff NX-CHK |

| R-248 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND22_20261012.md §6 (R22-Q1; binding), re-derived by R-250 | A paid but not-invoiced manager-signed Timesheet of a check-only client is corrected through Office's **Correct this Timesheet**. **HARD RULE (every state):** the replacement must itself be a manager-signed Timesheet with the new hours (the worker enters them in MyTMS, the manager signs); Office never types or edits signed hours (a guard beside `contract_week_manual_upsert_atomic`, `CHECK_ONLY_SIGNED_HOURS_OFFICE_EDIT_REFUSED`) and never authorises an unsigned replacement (Worker route plus deferred trigger, `CHECK_ONLY_REPLACEMENT_NOT_SIGNED`). **Since R-250** it uses the same mechanism as R-249: the original stays current and untouched; a replacement P0 waits in MyTMS; R0 and the signed P0 are authorised together; Cancel correction discards P0; the paid finance row is never moved or zeroed. The earlier reject-and-rotate route (extending `candidate_submission_reject_atomic_v1`, `_candidate_timesheet_reject_rotate_v1`, `_candidate_record_capabilities_v1`) is **withdrawn**. Not invoiced → placement `COMPLETE_UNINVOICED_PARENT` (R0 needs no line). Pay nets to the difference. GO-LIVE gate: NEXT nets the chain and keeps the paid revision's snapshot (handoff NX-CHK). | `03` §28.6 |

| R-249 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND22_20261012.md §6 (R22-Q2; binding) | A manager-signed Timesheet on an ISSUED invoice is corrected by a whole reversal plus a manager-signed replacement filled in by the worker in MyTMS, authorised together; a per-Timesheet credit note (round 21); the corrected Timesheet on a new invoice; other workers stay on the original invoice; pay nets to the difference. If the invoice never reached the client, Office may unissue first and it becomes a same-invoice draft round trip with the signed replacement. Built by EXTENDING the whole-correction owner (scope preset or check-only; origin `SIGNED_TIMESHEET_CORRECTION`; P0 at Send, R0 at Authorise both, Cancel correction), the pair-unit arms, the per-Timesheet credit note and the round-trip wrapper. **No route-family successor:** `_candidate_route_family_v1` already returns ELECTRONIC for an ELECTRONIC week snapshot (`24092026_2247…:172-176`); WP-0 proves that the Candidate listing and transition accept the adjustment week. NEXT chain netting NX-AI-3 is extended. | `03` §28.6, §26.6.2, §26.6.3, §25.2 |

| R-250 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND22_20261012.md §7 (R22C-Q1; binding; the critic's recommendation) | The original stays until replaced. In every state (authorised, paid, on a draft, issued), the original signed Timesheet stays current and untouched while a replacement draft waits in MyTMS for the worker to fill in and the manager to sign; nothing (pay, invoice or records) changes until Office authorises the signed replacement together with its reversal; Office has **Cancel correction**, which discards the draft; the paid finance row is never moved or zeroed (Policy X). One mechanism covers every state; it supersedes the reject-and-rotate route of R-248. | `03` §28.6 |

| R-253 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND22_20261012.md §9 (binding) | A reversal/replacement pair is authorised and unauthorised together through BOTH the single and the bulk authorise, starting from either member, with the same result and the same confirmation ("Both timesheets will be authorised together"; button "Authorise both" / "Unauthorise both"); in bulk one member or both is one unit. Reuses the existing expansion (`21072026_1235_00…:435-470`), the single pair flow and the bulk route, with the WHOLE arm for both origins; an unsigned check-only replacement is refused through every entry point. | `03` §28.9, §26.6.2 |

| R-255 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND22_20261012.md §11 (binding; UI critic Q2) | For check-only clients, **Correct this Timesheet** is also used for a manager-signed Timesheet that is **not yet authorised**, in place of today's Reject (state A0). The original stays untouched; at **Authorise both** the original, its reversal and the signed replacement are authorised together in one action, so only the corrected hours count and are paid; placement `COMPLETE_UNINVOICED_PARENT`. Reject of the **hours** is not offered for a signed check-only version, and the Office reject route refuses rejecting its hours (`CONTRACT_HOURS` / `CONTRACT_COMBINED`; `CHECK_ONLY_USE_CORRECT_THIS_TIMESHEET`, a Worker-route guard; the Candidate reject owner is not extended); rejecting an expense claim is unchanged (critic UI R2-5). In A0 the original is never shown as a plain "Authorised" in records or MyTMS, no authorised notification is sent, only the correction item shows while it waits, a lone Authorise of T0 warns, and NEXT pays exactly the replacement with no false overpayment (critic UI R2-4; handoff NX-CHK). | `03` §28.6, §28.9, §27.2 H |

| R-258 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND22_20261012.md §11 (binding; UI critic F15) | A daily correction is designed the same way as the weekly one. For a correction only, the MyTMS daily shift screen (`app/daily/shift.tsx`) shows "We've prefilled this with the corrected hours", highlights the changed times ("Changed: was … · now …"), says "If you think this is wrong, please call the office" and skips "Were these booked hours correct?"; it prefills from replacement draft schedule through existing dailySegments with correction-owned draft/alias/continuation initialization; only changed start/finish/break fields show exact original/proposed deltas; the worker confirms and sends, and the manager signs. **Critic UI R2-2:** the daily replacement's detail carries `daily_shift` frozen from the original booking, so it reaches the daily screen even after the booking has left the Rota window. | `03` §28.6, §27.2 H |

original_workgroup_rule_evidence.exact_text: | R-195 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND7_20261012.md | A protected-pay action (Protect pay, Amend, Withdraw/Unprotect, Record not worked, Reconcile / Accept source hours and reconcile, Wait) is allowed for an active user who is EITHER role admin (nothing else needed) OR has payment authoriser OR has golden key, whatever their role; one person, never a second approver; every other operation keeps its current rule. Explicit owner-approved scope exception (all Weekly Source clients, NHSP included), beside R-003 and R-175; replaces admin AND (authoriser OR golden key). Extended by round 8 to every pay-changing action (R-201). | WP-PP §25 |

| R-201 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND8_20261012.md | Every pay-changing action in scope — first Authorise and unauthorise/return of a Weekly Source week, all protected-pay actions, Accept source, Keep as paid, release of a pay hold, the later-change pay decision — uses the predicate active AND (admin OR payment authoriser OR golden key); one person; first Authorise is widened (no stricter check). A non-admin authoriser's Weekly Source/Imports workspace offers every pay-changing action and pay-related query and nothing else (uploads, import/group settings, invoice actions and Checklist confirmations stay admin-only). Weekly Source only (all groups incl. NHSP), plus — because the agency-invoice preset is in this plan's scope — the ordinary authorise/unauthorise, pair authorise, Protect pay and pay-state change of a Timesheet for which the agency-invoice preset predicate is true (`03` §26.3); every other ordinary, Daily and TIMESHEET_AUTHORITY authorisation outside Weekly Source is unchanged here. Extends R-195. Refined by R-234 (round 19): the Checklist is visible to a non-admin authoriser read-only, pay rows only. | WP-PP §25.1 |

| R-216 | owner via coordinator 12/10/2026 (one permission check); rounds 7–8 | The rule active AND (admin OR payment_authoriser OR payment_golden_key) exists once in SQL (`private.weekly_source_pay_actor_allowed_v1`) and once in the Worker (`broker/src/payment-actor-permission.js`); the shared check, the inline SQL sites S2–S10, the widened Worker sites W13–W17 call it; W1–W12 converge through handoff NX-WAIT (they already implement the same predicate and are not edited here; critic R8 item 19); Banking-named copies via handoff NX-WAIT. | `03` §25 |

| R-222 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND15_20261012.md items 2 and 7, and the owner-confirmed reconciliation | The invoiceable Timesheet holds **finalised HealthRoster shifts only**; an unfinalised shift, protected or not, is never on it. An **unprotected** waiting shift does not hold the invoice. A **protected** waiting shift **holds the week's invoice** until HealthRoster finalises it or Office unprotects it; unprotect = deemed not worked, the protected pay becomes an overpayment of the difference (never refused), and the week can then be invoiced. A protected shift finalised later is **always added to T0**, which cannot yet be invoiced, and its pay is **netted** against the protected pay already paid, by `candidate_id + work_date + work_event_id` (R-230; within T0's work normally, and across works whenever the shift or T0 lands on another work), never `booking_id`, `segment_id` or Request Id: top-up / overpayment of the difference / nothing. Then the protection clears and the shift becomes invoiceable. A new Timesheet is used **only after issue**: a new shift → new Timesheet and new invoice; changed or removed hours → R0/P0 and a credit note for that Timesheet only (R-240; round 17 item 3 removed the post-authorisation query case). | `03` §26.5 items 1, 3, 6; handoff NX-AI-6 |

original_workgroup_rule_evidence.exact_text: | R-195 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND7_20261012.md | A protected-pay action (Protect pay, Amend, Withdraw/Unprotect, Record not worked, Reconcile / Accept source hours and reconcile, Wait) is allowed for an active user who is EITHER role admin (nothing else needed) OR has payment authoriser OR has golden key, whatever their role; one person, never a second approver; every other operation keeps its current rule. Explicit owner-approved scope exception (all Weekly Source clients, NHSP included), beside R-003 and R-175; replaces admin AND (authoriser OR golden key). Extended by round 8 to every pay-changing action (R-201). | WP-PP §25 |

| R-201 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND8_20261012.md | Every pay-changing action in scope — first Authorise and unauthorise/return of a Weekly Source week, all protected-pay actions, Accept source, Keep as paid, release of a pay hold, the later-change pay decision — uses the predicate active AND (admin OR payment authoriser OR golden key); one person; first Authorise is widened (no stricter check). A non-admin authoriser's Weekly Source/Imports workspace offers every pay-changing action and pay-related query and nothing else (uploads, import/group settings, invoice actions and Checklist confirmations stay admin-only). Weekly Source only (all groups incl. NHSP), plus — because the agency-invoice preset is in this plan's scope — the ordinary authorise/unauthorise, pair authorise, Protect pay and pay-state change of a Timesheet for which the agency-invoice preset predicate is true (`03` §26.3); every other ordinary, Daily and TIMESHEET_AUTHORITY authorisation outside Weekly Source is unchanged here. Extends R-195. Refined by R-234 (round 19): the Checklist is visible to a non-admin authoriser read-only, pay rows only. | WP-PP §25.1 |

| R-216 | owner via coordinator 12/10/2026 (one permission check); rounds 7–8 | The rule active AND (admin OR payment_authoriser OR payment_golden_key) exists once in SQL (`private.weekly_source_pay_actor_allowed_v1`) and once in the Worker (`broker/src/payment-actor-permission.js`); the shared check, the inline SQL sites S2–S10, the widened Worker sites W13–W17 call it; W1–W12 converge through handoff NX-WAIT (they already implement the same predicate and are not edited here; critic R8 item 19); Banking-named copies via handoff NX-WAIT. | `03` §25 |

| R-222 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND15_20261012.md items 2 and 7, and the owner-confirmed reconciliation | The invoiceable Timesheet holds **finalised HealthRoster shifts only**; an unfinalised shift, protected or not, is never on it. An **unprotected** waiting shift does not hold the invoice. A **protected** waiting shift **holds the week's invoice** until HealthRoster finalises it or Office unprotects it; unprotect = deemed not worked, the protected pay becomes an overpayment of the difference (never refused), and the week can then be invoiced. A protected shift finalised later is **always added to T0**, which cannot yet be invoiced, and its pay is **netted** against the protected pay already paid, by `candidate_id + work_date + work_event_id` (R-230; within T0's work normally, and across works whenever the shift or T0 lands on another work), never `booking_id`, `segment_id` or Request Id: top-up / overpayment of the difference / nothing. Then the protection clears and the shift becomes invoiceable. A new Timesheet is used **only after issue**: a new shift → new Timesheet and new invoice; changed or removed hours → R0/P0 and a credit note for that Timesheet only (R-240; round 17 item 3 removed the post-authorisation query case). | `03` §26.5 items 1, 3, 6; handoff NX-AI-6 |

original_workgroup_rule_evidence.exact_text: | R-195 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND7_20261012.md | A protected-pay action (Protect pay, Amend, Withdraw/Unprotect, Record not worked, Reconcile / Accept source hours and reconcile, Wait) is allowed for an active user who is EITHER role admin (nothing else needed) OR has payment authoriser OR has golden key, whatever their role; one person, never a second approver; every other operation keeps its current rule. Explicit owner-approved scope exception (all Weekly Source clients, NHSP included), beside R-003 and R-175; replaces admin AND (authoriser OR golden key). Extended by round 8 to every pay-changing action (R-201). | WP-PP §25 |

| R-201 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND8_20261012.md | Every pay-changing action in scope — first Authorise and unauthorise/return of a Weekly Source week, all protected-pay actions, Accept source, Keep as paid, release of a pay hold, the later-change pay decision — uses the predicate active AND (admin OR payment authoriser OR golden key); one person; first Authorise is widened (no stricter check). A non-admin authoriser's Weekly Source/Imports workspace offers every pay-changing action and pay-related query and nothing else (uploads, import/group settings, invoice actions and Checklist confirmations stay admin-only). Weekly Source only (all groups incl. NHSP), plus — because the agency-invoice preset is in this plan's scope — the ordinary authorise/unauthorise, pair authorise, Protect pay and pay-state change of a Timesheet for which the agency-invoice preset predicate is true (`03` §26.3); every other ordinary, Daily and TIMESHEET_AUTHORITY authorisation outside Weekly Source is unchanged here. Extends R-195. Refined by R-234 (round 19): the Checklist is visible to a non-admin authoriser read-only, pay rows only. | WP-PP §25.1 |

| R-216 | owner via coordinator 12/10/2026 (one permission check); rounds 7–8 | The rule active AND (admin OR payment_authoriser OR payment_golden_key) exists once in SQL (`private.weekly_source_pay_actor_allowed_v1`) and once in the Worker (`broker/src/payment-actor-permission.js`); the shared check, the inline SQL sites S2–S10, the widened Worker sites W13–W17 call it; W1–W12 converge through handoff NX-WAIT (they already implement the same predicate and are not edited here; critic R8 item 19); Banking-named copies via handoff NX-WAIT. | `03` §25 |

| R-222 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND15_20261012.md items 2 and 7, and the owner-confirmed reconciliation | The invoiceable Timesheet holds **finalised HealthRoster shifts only**; an unfinalised shift, protected or not, is never on it. An **unprotected** waiting shift does not hold the invoice. A **protected** waiting shift **holds the week's invoice** until HealthRoster finalises it or Office unprotects it; unprotect = deemed not worked, the protected pay becomes an overpayment of the difference (never refused), and the week can then be invoiced. A protected shift finalised later is **always added to T0**, which cannot yet be invoiced, and its pay is **netted** against the protected pay already paid, by `candidate_id + work_date + work_event_id` (R-230; within T0's work normally, and across works whenever the shift or T0 lands on another work), never `booking_id`, `segment_id` or Request Id: top-up / overpayment of the difference / nothing. Then the protection clears and the shift becomes invoiceable. A new Timesheet is used **only after issue**: a new shift → new Timesheet and new invoice; changed or removed hours → R0/P0 and a credit note for that Timesheet only (R-240; round 17 item 3 removed the post-authorisation query case). | `03` §26.5 items 1, 3, 6; handoff NX-AI-6 |

original_workgroup_rule_evidence.exact_text: | R-195 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND7_20261012.md | A protected-pay action (Protect pay, Amend, Withdraw/Unprotect, Record not worked, Reconcile / Accept source hours and reconcile, Wait) is allowed for an active user who is EITHER role admin (nothing else needed) OR has payment authoriser OR has golden key, whatever their role; one person, never a second approver; every other operation keeps its current rule. Explicit owner-approved scope exception (all Weekly Source clients, NHSP included), beside R-003 and R-175; replaces admin AND (authoriser OR golden key). Extended by round 8 to every pay-changing action (R-201). | WP-PP §25 |

| R-201 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND8_20261012.md | Every pay-changing action in scope — first Authorise and unauthorise/return of a Weekly Source week, all protected-pay actions, Accept source, Keep as paid, release of a pay hold, the later-change pay decision — uses the predicate active AND (admin OR payment authoriser OR golden key); one person; first Authorise is widened (no stricter check). A non-admin authoriser's Weekly Source/Imports workspace offers every pay-changing action and pay-related query and nothing else (uploads, import/group settings, invoice actions and Checklist confirmations stay admin-only). Weekly Source only (all groups incl. NHSP), plus — because the agency-invoice preset is in this plan's scope — the ordinary authorise/unauthorise, pair authorise, Protect pay and pay-state change of a Timesheet for which the agency-invoice preset predicate is true (`03` §26.3); every other ordinary, Daily and TIMESHEET_AUTHORITY authorisation outside Weekly Source is unchanged here. Extends R-195. Refined by R-234 (round 19): the Checklist is visible to a non-admin authoriser read-only, pay rows only. | WP-PP §25.1 |

| R-216 | owner via coordinator 12/10/2026 (one permission check); rounds 7–8 | The rule active AND (admin OR payment_authoriser OR payment_golden_key) exists once in SQL (`private.weekly_source_pay_actor_allowed_v1`) and once in the Worker (`broker/src/payment-actor-permission.js`); the shared check, the inline SQL sites S2–S10, the widened Worker sites W13–W17 call it; W1–W12 converge through handoff NX-WAIT (they already implement the same predicate and are not edited here; critic R8 item 19); Banking-named copies via handoff NX-WAIT. | `03` §25 |

| R-222 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND15_20261012.md items 2 and 7, and the owner-confirmed reconciliation | The invoiceable Timesheet holds **finalised HealthRoster shifts only**; an unfinalised shift, protected or not, is never on it. An **unprotected** waiting shift does not hold the invoice. A **protected** waiting shift **holds the week's invoice** until HealthRoster finalises it or Office unprotects it; unprotect = deemed not worked, the protected pay becomes an overpayment of the difference (never refused), and the week can then be invoiced. A protected shift finalised later is **always added to T0**, which cannot yet be invoiced, and its pay is **netted** against the protected pay already paid, by `candidate_id + work_date + work_event_id` (R-230; within T0's work normally, and across works whenever the shift or T0 lands on another work), never `booking_id`, `segment_id` or Request Id: top-up / overpayment of the difference / nothing. Then the protection clears and the shift becomes invoiceable. A new Timesheet is used **only after issue**: a new shift → new Timesheet and new invoice; changed or removed hours → R0/P0 and a credit note for that Timesheet only (R-240; round 17 item 3 removed the post-authorisation query case). | `03` §26.5 items 1, 3, 6; handoff NX-AI-6 |

original_workgroup_rule_evidence.exact_text: | R-195 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND7_20261012.md | A protected-pay action (Protect pay, Amend, Withdraw/Unprotect, Record not worked, Reconcile / Accept source hours and reconcile, Wait) is allowed for an active user who is EITHER role admin (nothing else needed) OR has payment authoriser OR has golden key, whatever their role; one person, never a second approver; every other operation keeps its current rule. Explicit owner-approved scope exception (all Weekly Source clients, NHSP included), beside R-003 and R-175; replaces admin AND (authoriser OR golden key). Extended by round 8 to every pay-changing action (R-201). | WP-PP §25 |

| R-201 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND8_20261012.md | Every pay-changing action in scope — first Authorise and unauthorise/return of a Weekly Source week, all protected-pay actions, Accept source, Keep as paid, release of a pay hold, the later-change pay decision — uses the predicate active AND (admin OR payment authoriser OR golden key); one person; first Authorise is widened (no stricter check). A non-admin authoriser's Weekly Source/Imports workspace offers every pay-changing action and pay-related query and nothing else (uploads, import/group settings, invoice actions and Checklist confirmations stay admin-only). Weekly Source only (all groups incl. NHSP), plus — because the agency-invoice preset is in this plan's scope — the ordinary authorise/unauthorise, pair authorise, Protect pay and pay-state change of a Timesheet for which the agency-invoice preset predicate is true (`03` §26.3); every other ordinary, Daily and TIMESHEET_AUTHORITY authorisation outside Weekly Source is unchanged here. Extends R-195. Refined by R-234 (round 19): the Checklist is visible to a non-admin authoriser read-only, pay rows only. | WP-PP §25.1 |

| R-216 | owner via coordinator 12/10/2026 (one permission check); rounds 7–8 | The rule active AND (admin OR payment_authoriser OR payment_golden_key) exists once in SQL (`private.weekly_source_pay_actor_allowed_v1`) and once in the Worker (`broker/src/payment-actor-permission.js`); the shared check, the inline SQL sites S2–S10, the widened Worker sites W13–W17 call it; W1–W12 converge through handoff NX-WAIT (they already implement the same predicate and are not edited here; critic R8 item 19); Banking-named copies via handoff NX-WAIT. | `03` §25 |

| R-222 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND15_20261012.md items 2 and 7, and the owner-confirmed reconciliation | The invoiceable Timesheet holds **finalised HealthRoster shifts only**; an unfinalised shift, protected or not, is never on it. An **unprotected** waiting shift does not hold the invoice. A **protected** waiting shift **holds the week's invoice** until HealthRoster finalises it or Office unprotects it; unprotect = deemed not worked, the protected pay becomes an overpayment of the difference (never refused), and the week can then be invoiced. A protected shift finalised later is **always added to T0**, which cannot yet be invoiced, and its pay is **netted** against the protected pay already paid, by `candidate_id + work_date + work_event_id` (R-230; within T0's work normally, and across works whenever the shift or T0 lands on another work), never `booking_id`, `segment_id` or Request Id: top-up / overpayment of the difference / nothing. Then the protection clears and the shift becomes invoiceable. A new Timesheet is used **only after issue**: a new shift → new Timesheet and new invoice; changed or removed hours → R0/P0 and a credit note for that Timesheet only (R-240; round 17 item 3 removed the post-authorisation query case). | `03` §26.5 items 1, 3, 6; handoff NX-AI-6 |

| R-201 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND8_20261012.md | Every pay-changing action in scope — first Authorise and unauthorise/return of a Weekly Source week, all protected-pay actions, Accept source, Keep as paid, release of a pay hold, the later-change pay decision — uses the predicate active AND (admin OR payment authoriser OR golden key); one person; first Authorise is widened (no stricter check). Extends R-195. Refined by R-234 (round 19): the Checklist is visible to a non-admin authoriser read-only, pay rows only. | WP-PP §25.1 |

Then the protection clears and the shift becomes invoiceable. A new Timesheet is used **only after issue**: a new shift → new Timesheet and new invoice; changed or removed hours → R0/P0 and a credit note for that Timesheet only (R-240; round 17 item 3 removed the post-authorisation query case). | `03` §26.5 items 1, 3, 6; handoff NX-AI-6 |

original_workgroup_rule_evidence.exact_text: | R-195 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND7_20261012.md | A protected-pay action (Protect pay, Amend, Withdraw/Unprotect, Record not worked, Reconcile / Accept source hours and reconcile, Wait) is allowed for an active user who is EITHER role admin (nothing else needed) OR has payment authoriser OR has golden key, whatever their role; one person, never a second approver; every other operation keeps its current rule. Explicit owner-approved scope exception (all Weekly Source clients, NHSP included), beside R-003 and R-175; replaces admin AND (authoriser OR golden key). Extended by round 8 to every pay-changing action (R-201). | WP-PP §25 |

| R-201 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND8_20261012.md | Every pay-changing action in scope — first Authorise and unauthorise/return of a Weekly Source week, all protected-pay actions, Accept source, Keep as paid, release of a pay hold, the later-change pay decision — uses the predicate active AND (admin OR payment authoriser OR golden key); one person; first Authorise is widened (no stricter check). A non-admin authoriser's Weekly Source/Imports workspace offers every pay-changing action and pay-related query and nothing else (uploads, import/group settings, invoice actions and Checklist confirmations stay admin-only). Weekly Source only (all groups incl. NHSP), plus — because the agency-invoice preset is in this plan's scope — the ordinary authorise/unauthorise, pair authorise, Protect pay and pay-state change of a Timesheet for which the agency-invoice preset predicate is true (`03` §26.3); every other ordinary, Daily and TIMESHEET_AUTHORITY authorisation outside Weekly Source is unchanged here. Extends R-195. Refined by R-234 (round 19): the Checklist is visible to a non-admin authoriser read-only, pay rows only. | WP-PP §25.1 |

| R-216 | owner via coordinator 12/10/2026 (one permission check); rounds 7–8 | The rule active AND (admin OR payment_authoriser OR payment_golden_key) exists once in SQL (`private.weekly_source_pay_actor_allowed_v1`) and once in the Worker (`broker/src/payment-actor-permission.js`); the shared check, the inline SQL sites S2–S10, the widened Worker sites W13–W17 call it; W1–W12 converge through handoff NX-WAIT (they already implement the same predicate and are not edited here; critic R8 item 19); Banking-named copies via handoff NX-WAIT. | `03` §25 |

| R-222 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND15_20261012.md items 2 and 7, and the owner-confirmed reconciliation | The invoiceable Timesheet holds **finalised HealthRoster shifts only**; an unfinalised shift, protected or not, is never on it. An **unprotected** waiting shift does not hold the invoice. A **protected** waiting shift **holds the week's invoice** until HealthRoster finalises it or Office unprotects it; unprotect = deemed not worked, the protected pay becomes an overpayment of the difference (never refused), and the week can then be invoiced. A protected shift finalised later is **always added to T0**, which cannot yet be invoiced, and its pay is **netted** against the protected pay already paid, by `candidate_id + work_date + work_event_id` (R-230; within T0's work normally, and across works whenever the shift or T0 lands on another work), never `booking_id`, `segment_id` or Request Id: top-up / overpayment of the difference / nothing. Then the protection clears and the shift becomes invoiceable. A new Timesheet is used **only after issue**: a new shift → new Timesheet and new invoice; changed or removed hours → R0/P0 and a credit note for that Timesheet only (R-240; round 17 item 3 removed the post-authorisation query case). | `03` §26.5 items 1, 3, 6; handoff NX-AI-6 |

original_workgroup_rule_evidence.exact_text: | R-195 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND7_20261012.md | A protected-pay action (Protect pay, Amend, Withdraw/Unprotect, Record not worked, Reconcile / Accept source hours and reconcile, Wait) is allowed for an active user who is EITHER role admin (nothing else needed) OR has payment authoriser OR has golden key, whatever their role; one person, never a second approver; every other operation keeps its current rule. Explicit owner-approved scope exception (all Weekly Source clients, NHSP included), beside R-003 and R-175; replaces admin AND (authoriser OR golden key). Extended by round 8 to every pay-changing action (R-201). | WP-PP §25 |

| R-201 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND8_20261012.md | Every pay-changing action in scope — first Authorise and unauthorise/return of a Weekly Source week, all protected-pay actions, Accept source, Keep as paid, release of a pay hold, the later-change pay decision — uses the predicate active AND (admin OR payment authoriser OR golden key); one person; first Authorise is widened (no stricter check). A non-admin authoriser's Weekly Source/Imports workspace offers every pay-changing action and pay-related query and nothing else (uploads, import/group settings, invoice actions and Checklist confirmations stay admin-only). Weekly Source only (all groups incl. NHSP), plus — because the agency-invoice preset is in this plan's scope — the ordinary authorise/unauthorise, pair authorise, Protect pay and pay-state change of a Timesheet for which the agency-invoice preset predicate is true (`03` §26.3); every other ordinary, Daily and TIMESHEET_AUTHORITY authorisation outside Weekly Source is unchanged here. Extends R-195. Refined by R-234 (round 19): the Checklist is visible to a non-admin authoriser read-only, pay rows only. | WP-PP §25.1 |

| R-216 | owner via coordinator 12/10/2026 (one permission check); rounds 7–8 | The rule active AND (admin OR payment_authoriser OR payment_golden_key) exists once in SQL (`private.weekly_source_pay_actor_allowed_v1`) and once in the Worker (`broker/src/payment-actor-permission.js`); the shared check, the inline SQL sites S2–S10, the widened Worker sites W13–W17 call it; W1–W12 converge through handoff NX-WAIT (they already implement the same predicate and are not edited here; critic R8 item 19); Banking-named copies via handoff NX-WAIT. | `03` §25 |

| R-222 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND15_20261012.md items 2 and 7, and the owner-confirmed reconciliation | The invoiceable Timesheet holds **finalised HealthRoster shifts only**; an unfinalised shift, protected or not, is never on it. An **unprotected** waiting shift does not hold the invoice. A **protected** waiting shift **holds the week's invoice** until HealthRoster finalises it or Office unprotects it; unprotect = deemed not worked, the protected pay becomes an overpayment of the difference (never refused), and the week can then be invoiced. A protected shift finalised later is **always added to T0**, which cannot yet be invoiced, and its pay is **netted** against the protected pay already paid, by `candidate_id + work_date + work_event_id` (R-230; within T0's work normally, and across works whenever the shift or T0 lands on another work), never `booking_id`, `segment_id` or Request Id: top-up / overpayment of the difference / nothing. Then the protection clears and the shift becomes invoiceable. A new Timesheet is used **only after issue**: a new shift → new Timesheet and new invoice; changed or removed hours → R0/P0 and a credit note for that Timesheet only (R-240; round 17 item 3 removed the post-authorisation query case). | `03` §26.5 items 1, 3, 6; handoff NX-AI-6 |

original_workgroup_rule_evidence.exact_text: | R-195 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND7_20261012.md | A protected-pay action (Protect pay, Amend, Withdraw/Unprotect, Record not worked, Reconcile / Accept source hours and reconcile, Wait) is allowed for an active user who is EITHER role admin (nothing else needed) OR has payment authoriser OR has golden key, whatever their role; one person, never a second approver; every other operation keeps its current rule. Explicit owner-approved scope exception (all Weekly Source clients, NHSP included), beside R-003 and R-175; replaces admin AND (authoriser OR golden key). Extended by round 8 to every pay-changing action (R-201). | WP-PP §25 |

| R-201 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND8_20261012.md | Every pay-changing action in scope — first Authorise and unauthorise/return of a Weekly Source week, all protected-pay actions, Accept source, Keep as paid, release of a pay hold, the later-change pay decision — uses the predicate active AND (admin OR payment authoriser OR golden key); one person; first Authorise is widened (no stricter check). A non-admin authoriser's Weekly Source/Imports workspace offers every pay-changing action and pay-related query and nothing else (uploads, import/group settings, invoice actions and Checklist confirmations stay admin-only). Weekly Source only (all groups incl. NHSP), plus — because the agency-invoice preset is in this plan's scope — the ordinary authorise/unauthorise, pair authorise, Protect pay and pay-state change of a Timesheet for which the agency-invoice preset predicate is true (`03` §26.3); every other ordinary, Daily and TIMESHEET_AUTHORITY authorisation outside Weekly Source is unchanged here. Extends R-195. Refined by R-234 (round 19): the Checklist is visible to a non-admin authoriser read-only, pay rows only. | WP-PP §25.1 |

| R-216 | owner via coordinator 12/10/2026 (one permission check); rounds 7–8 | The rule active AND (admin OR payment_authoriser OR payment_golden_key) exists once in SQL (`private.weekly_source_pay_actor_allowed_v1`) and once in the Worker (`broker/src/payment-actor-permission.js`); the shared check, the inline SQL sites S2–S10, the widened Worker sites W13–W17 call it; W1–W12 converge through handoff NX-WAIT (they already implement the same predicate and are not edited here; critic R8 item 19); Banking-named copies via handoff NX-WAIT. | `03` §25 |

| R-222 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND15_20261012.md items 2 and 7, and the owner-confirmed reconciliation | The invoiceable Timesheet holds **finalised HealthRoster shifts only**; an unfinalised shift, protected or not, is never on it. An **unprotected** waiting shift does not hold the invoice. A **protected** waiting shift **holds the week's invoice** until HealthRoster finalises it or Office unprotects it; unprotect = deemed not worked, the protected pay becomes an overpayment of the difference (never refused), and the week can then be invoiced. A protected shift finalised later is **always added to T0**, which cannot yet be invoiced, and its pay is **netted** against the protected pay already paid, by `candidate_id + work_date + work_event_id` (R-230; within T0's work normally, and across works whenever the shift or T0 lands on another work), never `booking_id`, `segment_id` or Request Id: top-up / overpayment of the difference / nothing. Then the protection clears and the shift becomes invoiceable. A new Timesheet is used **only after issue**: a new shift → new Timesheet and new invoice; changed or removed hours → R0/P0 and a credit note for that Timesheet only (R-240; round 17 item 3 removed the post-authorisation query case). | `03` §26.5 items 1, 3, 6; handoff NX-AI-6 |

original_workgroup_rule_evidence.exact_text: | R-195 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND7_20261012.md | A protected-pay action (Protect pay, Amend, Withdraw/Unprotect, Record not worked, Reconcile / Accept source hours and reconcile, Wait) is allowed for an active user who is EITHER role admin (nothing else needed) OR has payment authoriser OR has golden key, whatever their role; one person, never a second approver; every other operation keeps its current rule. Explicit owner-approved scope exception (all Weekly Source clients, NHSP included), beside R-003 and R-175; replaces admin AND (authoriser OR golden key). Extended by round 8 to every pay-changing action (R-201). | WP-PP §25 |

| R-201 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND8_20261012.md | Every pay-changing action in scope — first Authorise and unauthorise/return of a Weekly Source week, all protected-pay actions, Accept source, Keep as paid, release of a pay hold, the later-change pay decision — uses the predicate active AND (admin OR payment authoriser OR golden key); one person; first Authorise is widened (no stricter check). A non-admin authoriser's Weekly Source/Imports workspace offers every pay-changing action and pay-related query and nothing else (uploads, import/group settings, invoice actions and Checklist confirmations stay admin-only). Weekly Source only (all groups incl. NHSP), plus — because the agency-invoice preset is in this plan's scope — the ordinary authorise/unauthorise, pair authorise, Protect pay and pay-state change of a Timesheet for which the agency-invoice preset predicate is true (`03` §26.3); every other ordinary, Daily and TIMESHEET_AUTHORITY authorisation outside Weekly Source is unchanged here. Extends R-195. Refined by R-234 (round 19): the Checklist is visible to a non-admin authoriser read-only, pay rows only. | WP-PP §25.1 |

| R-216 | owner via coordinator 12/10/2026 (one permission check); rounds 7–8 | The rule active AND (admin OR payment_authoriser OR payment_golden_key) exists once in SQL (`private.weekly_source_pay_actor_allowed_v1`) and once in the Worker (`broker/src/payment-actor-permission.js`); the shared check, the inline SQL sites S2–S10, the widened Worker sites W13–W17 call it; W1–W12 converge through handoff NX-WAIT (they already implement the same predicate and are not edited here; critic R8 item 19); Banking-named copies via handoff NX-WAIT. | `03` §25 |

| R-222 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND15_20261012.md items 2 and 7, and the owner-confirmed reconciliation | The invoiceable Timesheet holds **finalised HealthRoster shifts only**; an unfinalised shift, protected or not, is never on it. An **unprotected** waiting shift does not hold the invoice. A **protected** waiting shift **holds the week's invoice** until HealthRoster finalises it or Office unprotects it; unprotect = deemed not worked, the protected pay becomes an overpayment of the difference (never refused), and the week can then be invoiced. A protected shift finalised later is **always added to T0**, which cannot yet be invoiced, and its pay is **netted** against the protected pay already paid, by `candidate_id + work_date + work_event_id` (R-230; within T0's work normally, and across works whenever the shift or T0 lands on another work), never `booking_id`, `segment_id` or Request Id: top-up / overpayment of the difference / nothing. Then the protection clears and the shift becomes invoiceable. A new Timesheet is used **only after issue**: a new shift → new Timesheet and new invoice; changed or removed hours → R0/P0 and a credit note for that Timesheet only (R-240; round 17 item 3 removed the post-authorisation query case). | `03` §26.5 items 1, 3, 6; handoff NX-AI-6 |

original_workgroup_rule_evidence.exact_text: | R-195 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND7_20261012.md | A protected-pay action (Protect pay, Amend, Withdraw/Unprotect, Record not worked, Reconcile / Accept source hours and reconcile, Wait) is allowed for an active user who is EITHER role admin (nothing else needed) OR has payment authoriser OR has golden key, whatever their role; one person, never a second approver; every other operation keeps its current rule. Explicit owner-approved scope exception (all Weekly Source clients, NHSP included), beside R-003 and R-175; replaces admin AND (authoriser OR golden key). Extended by round 8 to every pay-changing action (R-201). | WP-PP §25 |

| R-201 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND8_20261012.md | Every pay-changing action in scope — first Authorise and unauthorise/return of a Weekly Source week, all protected-pay actions, Accept source, Keep as paid, release of a pay hold, the later-change pay decision — uses the predicate active AND (admin OR payment authoriser OR golden key); one person; first Authorise is widened (no stricter check). A non-admin authoriser's Weekly Source/Imports workspace offers every pay-changing action and pay-related query and nothing else (uploads, import/group settings, invoice actions and Checklist confirmations stay admin-only). Weekly Source only (all groups incl. NHSP), plus — because the agency-invoice preset is in this plan's scope — the ordinary authorise/unauthorise, pair authorise, Protect pay and pay-state change of a Timesheet for which the agency-invoice preset predicate is true (`03` §26.3); every other ordinary, Daily and TIMESHEET_AUTHORITY authorisation outside Weekly Source is unchanged here. Extends R-195. Refined by R-234 (round 19): the Checklist is visible to a non-admin authoriser read-only, pay rows only. | WP-PP §25.1 |

| R-216 | owner via coordinator 12/10/2026 (one permission check); rounds 7–8 | The rule active AND (admin OR payment_authoriser OR payment_golden_key) exists once in SQL (`private.weekly_source_pay_actor_allowed_v1`) and once in the Worker (`broker/src/payment-actor-permission.js`); the shared check, the inline SQL sites S2–S10, the widened Worker sites W13–W17 call it; W1–W12 converge through handoff NX-WAIT (they already implement the same predicate and are not edited here; critic R8 item 19); Banking-named copies via handoff NX-WAIT. | `03` §25 |

| R-222 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND15_20261012.md items 2 and 7, and the owner-confirmed reconciliation | The invoiceable Timesheet holds **finalised HealthRoster shifts only**; an unfinalised shift, protected or not, is never on it. An **unprotected** waiting shift does not hold the invoice. A **protected** waiting shift **holds the week's invoice** until HealthRoster finalises it or Office unprotects it; unprotect = deemed not worked, the protected pay becomes an overpayment of the difference (never refused), and the week can then be invoiced. A protected shift finalised later is **always added to T0**, which cannot yet be invoiced, and its pay is **netted** against the protected pay already paid, by `candidate_id + work_date + work_event_id` (R-230; within T0's work normally, and across works whenever the shift or T0 lands on another work), never `booking_id`, `segment_id` or Request Id: top-up / overpayment of the difference / nothing. Then the protection clears and the shift becomes invoiceable. A new Timesheet is used **only after issue**: a new shift → new Timesheet and new invoice; changed or removed hours → R0/P0 and a credit note for that Timesheet only (R-240; round 17 item 3 removed the post-authorisation query case). | `03` §26.5 items 1, 3, 6; handoff NX-AI-6 |

| R-201 | OWNER_ANSWERS_ROUND8_20261012.md | Every pay-changing action in scope — first Authorise and unauthorise/return of a Weekly Source week, all protected-pay actions, Accept source, Keep as paid, release of a pay hold, the later-change pay decision — uses the predicate active AND (admin OR payment authoriser OR golden key); one person; first Authorise is widened (no stricter check).
